neighbors.name: Town Of The Dead Life 死寂之城
neighbors.short_description: 《Town Of The Dead Life》 is an independent game with the background of eschatology. Players will play the role of one of the few surviving humans in the end of the world, surviving in difficult conditions and trying to change the fate of the world.

neighbors.name: Open Headcount: A Corporate-Hell Roguelike
neighbors.short_description: A corporate-hell roguelike auto-battler. Hire a disposable worker, build game-breaking combos out of office junk, and send them up the corporate ladder through the circles of Limbo Corp. When they burn out, open a new headcount. The only way out is up.

neighbors.name: Last Sighting
neighbors.short_description: Wake up to the sound of your neighbors dog outside. Take your trusty lantern and escort him home. With night looming. Use your lantern to guide you on your way. With something lurking in the night and your car broken down you'll have to find a way to defend yourself as you make your way to safety.

neighbors.name: Twell
neighbors.short_description: This adventure is about you waking up in this world named Twell. The only thing you can do now is explore what this world has to offer. Explore 8 unique dungeons, discover many secrets and visit many locations.

neighbors.name: Dinos Reborn
neighbors.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of Dinos Reborn and feel like a dinosaur hunter! Danger awaits you at every turn. Think fast and don't hesitate, because every second lost can turn you from hunter to prey...

neighbors.name: Ralf's Adventure: Aztec Mystery
neighbors.short_description: Take up the Bat! Ralf's Adventure: Aztec Mystery is a top-down action-adventure game with puzzles and platforming. This game is inspired by home console games from the '80s and '90s, but uses modern design sensibilities.

neighbors.name: Scream Light
neighbors.short_description: One place. Two realities. Neither is safe. Scream Light is a 4-player co-op horror game where your team crosses into a dark, abandoned version of the same world. Creatures react to sound, darkness can be deadly, and sometimes screaming is your only way out.

neighbors.name: The Dream Recorder
neighbors.short_description: In this narrative adventure game you’ll play as a lonely house cat left behind during a disaster. Explore the woods of the Pacific Northwest outside your home, build a community and break out of the cycle that traps you all.

neighbors.name: Rollamech
neighbors.short_description: Build a competitive mech on your stat sheet. Draft dice, shop the hangar, chase sponsorships, and win on Circuit Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

neighbors.name: Crowd Diver
neighbors.short_description: Crowd Diver is an asymmetrical stealth multiplayer game where you can immerse yourself in the role of the Seeker, tasked with protecting the city from impending evil. Alternatively, you can become the Monster, seeking to wreak destruction and eliminate targets disguised.

neighbors.name: Pivvot
neighbors.short_description: Pivvot is a thrilling game of strategic avoidance that will consistently test and challenge your ability to make quick, impulsive decisions. neighbors.short_description: Manage the flow of a fresh produce warehouse ! Place orders with suppliers, handle incoming pallets, and dispatch them from the loading bay to your customers. Stay cool under pressure ! Deal with the increasing pressure and unexpected events.

neighbors.name: Sono
neighbors.short_description: Sono is a 2D exploration game where players effortlessly glide through an abstract microcosm collecting lost fragments of sound.

neighbors.name: HU-man Dungeons
neighbors.short_description: The world's finest HU-man simulator! Explore dungeons, slash enemies, collect loot, fight bosses, just like HU-man used to do in their daily lives. Now with a direct uplink to the Compendium for real-time updates!

neighbors.short_description: Dream Walk: Mortgage is a top-down arcade-style game that requires on quick maneuvering and simple multitasking. While avoiding bad-guys, petting cats, and collecting sunflower seeds, you must also remember to click the interest button. Accumulate Dream-Dollars to buy new shoes and dream-houses.

neighbors.name: Feed The Void
neighbors.short_description: An incremental deckbuilder where you shape your deck the way you desire. Upgrade cards, unlock synergies, play massive combos, and constantly discover game-changing abilities.

neighbors.short_description: Become an apprentice of the famous Leonardo da Vinci. Solve handcrafted mechanical 3D puzzles and discover hidden secrets. Navigate through mesmerizing environments of the Italian Renaissance. Travel through time to influence your surroundings.

neighbors.name: Spot The Difference - PHOTO for TESLA and PC
neighbors.short_description: Find 5 differences between the two pictures in a limited time. The answer changes every time you play!

neighbors.short_description: Winner of four 2026 NYX Awards. Manage a classic shop through hardcore time management and order processing. Cook global cuisines, upgrade kitchen tech like Omni pots, and unlock fully automated branches. Enjoy refined animations while building your transnational culinary empire.

neighbors.name: Wilted Rails
neighbors.short_description: Wilted Rails is an action-adventure RPG with rogue-lite aspects; manage, crew, and upgrade your armoured train. Travel a war-stricken world stuck in boundless conflict. Defend your train as you explore the many fractured cultures, towns, and countries of the world

neighbors.name: Puzzle Nature

neighbors.name: Defense Zone 2

neighbors.name: Nature's Wrath
neighbors.short_description: In Nature's Wrath, a 2D action roguelike with puzzles, explore dangerous swamps full of hostile creatures and secrets. Gather resources for your village and survive the harsh environment. Can you face the challenges and make it out alive?

neighbors.name: 怪奇帖　～屋上の幽霊と悪魔の儀式～
neighbors.short_description: Maybe nothing happened... Or maybe something did. A fleeting moment from an ordinary high school day. A exploration horror game set in a school at night.

neighbors.name: Breakout Beyond
neighbors.short_description: Breakout is back! In this neon-drenched take on the classic, you’ll need to literally break through each puzzle by clearing bricks to breach the final goal. Rack up a combo and create spectacular light shows alone or with a friend.

neighbors.name: Wizard with a Gun
neighbors.short_description: Wizard with a Gun is an online sandbox survival game for 1 - 4 players set in a magical wilderness wrought with dangerous creatures and arcane mysteries. Embark on a journey alone or with a friend to collect, craft, and outfit your wizard however you see fit as you explore the unknown.

neighbors.name: Avernus
neighbors.short_description: Avernus is a challenging action-adventure game set in an ancient, mysterious tomb of a dead god. Delve into its labyrinthine halls and protect its secrets from a malevolent pretender.

neighbors.name: Wayward Manor
neighbors.short_description: Neil Gaiman & Wayward Manor invite you to jump into the afterlife of a disgruntled ghost, trying to reclaim his house from its newfound owners.

neighbors.name: Tony Stewart's All-American Racing
neighbors.short_description: In Tony Stewart’s All-American Racing, it’s always a Saturday night at the local short track! With three different styles of racing to choose from and a variety of tracks, it’s sure to be a good time for all!

neighbors.name: Great Again
neighbors.short_description: No pain, no gain. Give you extreme pain. But it can turn into extreme joy.

neighbors.name: Pushcat
neighbors.short_description: Pushing boulders, matching gems and mining silver... that's what life's all about.

neighbors.name: Ruby: Tunnel Vision
neighbors.short_description: A science fiction FPS game where you fight, explore, and outsmart your way through an alien invasion. Built as a mod for the Source engine.

neighbors.name: Ballrun 3D Marble Maze Speedrun
neighbors.short_description: You choose to play BallRun not because it is easy, but because it is hard, because the goal will serve to organize and measure the best BallRunners and their skills, because that challenge is one that you are willing to accept, one you are unwilling to postpone, and one which you intend to win.

neighbors.name: RAT LUCK
neighbors.short_description: Compete in precision timing rounds, choose which rat has to risk a hand, and survive a table full of dangerous cheese. Rat Luck is a chaotic 2–4 player online party game with proximity voice chat, bluffing, taunting, and terrible luck.

neighbors.name: Torchless
neighbors.short_description: Torchless is a dark and gothic dungeon crawler RPG played through a text-based retro console. Forge your party and take up arms against the horrors lurking within the dungeon halls in strategic, turn-based combat, clinging on to survival using everything at your disposal.

neighbors.name: Ideal Nightmare
neighbors.short_description: The dreams of the worshippers of an indescribable evil have been fulfilled, cloaked by the shadows survive the nightmare. Customize your arsenal to hunt the dark forces of hell sending them back from where they came from in a body bag.

neighbors.name: BasCatball Saturn: Basketball & Cat
neighbors.short_description: Play basketball. In Saturn. With cats. Are you ready for the whole galaxy's hardest matches? Solve puzzles and win the Bascatball intergalactic championship!

neighbors.name: Nefarius: The Last Wizard
neighbors.short_description: Nefarius, a powerful wizard, battles against an evil slime army that has drained his land of magic. Defeating these slimes allows him to reclaim his power through the magic shards they drop. Help Nefarius restore balance and save his realm from darkness.

neighbors.name: Limb From Limb
neighbors.short_description: The Raymond Mitchell Association personally invites you to join our new limb regrowth program. Engage in a game of chance against another patient, risking the loss of your fingers. We have provided items to aid in your success waiting to be uncovered as you traverse the game board.

neighbors.name: Cumrooms
neighbors.short_description: Cumrooms is a sexy exploration game about nocliping into rooms full of hot monster girls and trying to survive. neighbors.name: Canopy
neighbors.short_description: Break everything around you and assemble tools to help figure out how to get off a mysterious island.

neighbors.name: PIPELINE
neighbors.short_description: PIPELINE is a 1-6 player online co-op, physics-based, action FPS, rogue-lite where every bullet counts. Progress levels, ride around in the shopping cart, discover game-altering upgrades, get strong, fight even stronger enemies. Death is not the end. The cycle will repeat.

neighbors.name: stikir
neighbors.short_description: This game is about making this game.

neighbors.name: Ice Rescue Simulator VR

neighbors.name: IntuiCraft
neighbors.short_description: A minimalistic intuition trainer app designed to sharpen your intuitive senses and enhance your decision-making abilities.

neighbors.name: Crowbar Climber
neighbors.short_description: In Crowbar Climber, use your crowbars to make your way up! Face hooks, planks, and gears using only your arms. Can you beat the game before you run out of energy?

neighbors.name: Pocket Chef

neighbors.name: Monster Networking

neighbors.name: Aura Farming Simulator

neighbors.name: JNZ: Anchor Archetype
neighbors.short_description: An erotic life sim in which you must use Jungian psychology to confront meta-physical monsters that manifest in subconscious of girls in order to save them from tragedy.

neighbors.short_description: Float Gallery shows the work of artists working in the digital realm and supports aesthetic and cultural practice in virtual environments. neighbors.name: Arid Oasis Seeker

neighbors.name: Puddle

Through a 20-minute experience, you will step into a mental maze, looking back at the important moments that changed you, and see yourself again.

neighbors.short_description: "Heavenly Battle" is a Roguelite survivor-style horde survival game inspired by Chinese mythology and Journey to the West. Fight your way through the demon horde before the Pill Spirits consume the Southern Heavenly Gate — or the Three Realms will never know peace again...

neighbors.name: Shrimpact
neighbors.short_description: In Shrimpact you'll need to fight your friends! Use your boxing skills to punch eachother of the arena, but beware of the Clam who shoots out exploding pearls! Punch, throw and dash all you can in this chaotic battle!

neighbors.name: Welcome To... Chichester OVN 1 : The Beach
neighbors.short_description: Taking place on the unluckiest day of the year, the protagonist and his/her friends get an invite to "The Beach". Mistaking this for a private beach party, they are sorely disappointed when instead of everyone being able to have fun, they have to instead search for three parts of a missing sword.

neighbors.name: For the Revenge
neighbors.short_description: The world is filled with darkness by the devil. The last wizard left, you have to shine the light and defeat the devil to save the world. But be careful! As soon as the light is lit, a group of demons will come and attack you. Alone, you have to fight against hundreds of thousands of enemies!

neighbors.name: Silent Snow
neighbors.short_description: Seth and May have moved out of the city and into a big old house that uncle John decided he didnt want anymore. Although the holiday spirit brings color and joy to an otherwise barren house, something lurks outside hidden in the snow. Watching. Waiting.

neighbors.name: Twizzle Puzzle: Rodents

neighbors.name: Unplugged
neighbors.short_description: Play air guitar and write rock history in VR! Unplugged lets you rock out hard to some of the biggest rock songs, including The Offspring, Weezer & Ozzy Osbourne. Become a rock legend with Steel Panther’s Satchel as your mentor. Are you ready to ROCK?!

neighbors.name: Turn Back The Powers Of Darkness
neighbors.short_description: This game is an action oriented 3D fighting and shooting game. Players need to eliminate terrorists within a specified time frame, which belongs to the team death competition game mode. The team that destroys the most enemies wins. This game is a challenging third person shooter game.

neighbors.name: DFL2
neighbors.short_description: Endless runner inspired by American Football and the NFL. Embody a Running Back and dodge all the defenders on your way to the Endzone thanks to your skill moves !

neighbors.name: Cognizer
neighbors.short_description: A new puzzle game of wits and recognition.

neighbors.name: Rush Bros.
neighbors.short_description: Rush Bros. “Discover gameplay with custom music” Rush Bros is a music reactive Platform Racing Game that features a single player and a competitive multiplayer either split-screen local or online between two simultaneous racers.

neighbors.name: Puzzles Rats
neighbors.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

neighbors.name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
neighbors.short_description: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. neighbors.name: Pine Hollow

neighbors.name: Moto Knight
neighbors.short_description: Moto Knight is the world's first Motocross Dungeon Crawler! Navigate your way through dozens of trap-filled stages while trying to keep your dirtbike upright.

neighbors.name: Rake
neighbors.short_description: Do ghosts exist? What about Bigfoot, Chupacabras,Rake or Skinwalkers? And how will we ever know? You play as Gordon Davis, a scientist,a traveller and an explorer of unknown creatures and unusual events.

neighbors.name: Ding!
neighbors.short_description: A calming auto-merge strategy board game — featuring chime sounds, water droplets, and lots and lots of snowflakes.

neighbors.name: Ratmageddon Underground
neighbors.short_description: Splat your way through infested underground stations, sewers and tunnels overrun by zombified rats. Armed with improvised weapons, deadly traps and a well-aimed foot, help Alan fight his way home on a night he'll wish he could forget.

neighbors.name: Vector Wave
neighbors.short_description: Drop-in, pick-up powerful weapons and blast your friends into the void in this 2.5D party platform shooter, where the bullets don’t hurt, but the knockback does!

neighbors.name: Verse Jumper
neighbors.short_description: A multiverse-exploration platformer. A lone space explorer falls into a strange world—shift universe to find a route back to your ship.

neighbors.name: Moorhuhn Kart 2
neighbors.short_description: Moorhuhn Kart 2 Multiplayer Racing

neighbors.name: Touhou Brawl
neighbors.short_description: Solo or with friends — dungeons, brawls, and volleyball in one game! A roguelike dungeon crawler for solo or co-op, plus a skill-testing PVP brawl and reflex-driven superpower volleyball. Explore alone, then smash it up together when friends join!

neighbors.name: THE CANON OF BALLS
neighbors.short_description: Hardcore, co-op (or solo) platformer. Dark Souls makes a baby with Super Monkey Ball. An easy-to-learn, hard-to-master experience to explore with your friends. All inside a vast open world, with each platforming course bringing its own twist.

neighbors.name: Non-Fellows
neighbors.short_description: Follow adventures of four not as much friends as they finds their way through zombie city, get acquainted with an ancient vampire and discover what happened to their cute blonde friend after this meeting. Republish of an old point-and-click adventure, with all 3 episodes in a signle game.

neighbors.name: VARIABLE PICTOGRAM JUMP
neighbors.short_description: An instant death action game with flying pictographs. Use jumping and zooming in and out to reach your goal! In addition to the single mode, there is also a mode that allows up to four players to compete.

neighbors.name: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass
neighbors.short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

neighbors.name: Rustwing
neighbors.short_description: Rustwing is a twin stick shooter roguelike, set in the distant future. Navigate from star to star, battle the scattered factions of humanity, discover strange anomalies, customize your weaponry, acquire powerful upgrades and become a legendary pilot!

neighbors.name: Woman's body
neighbors.short_description: Is a card game with images of different female body parts that will test your memory. The aim of the game is to find pairs of cards

neighbors.name: FLYING SHOT

neighbors.name: Tales Of The Death
neighbors.short_description: Join a comic adventure in a hand-drawn book with a life of its own. Rearrange the panels of an animated comic to reveal the stories of the world of The Death.

neighbors.name: Souls ShowDown
neighbors.short_description: Eat, and then imagine. Souls ShowDown is a multiplayer FPS horror game.

neighbors.name: Fish. Love. Danger.
neighbors.short_description: A cute HARDCORE arcade game about a fish in love.

neighbors.name: Graviteer
neighbors.short_description: Graviteer is a fast-paced zero-gravity co-op game where you use a grappling hook and other gadgets to traverse a chaotic field of debris and escape before the big scary evil black hole eats all of you.

neighbors.name: Sort The Dumplings
neighbors.short_description: Sort a mountain of adorable dumplings into their proper homes in a chaotic, satisfying sorting game. Discover 190 unique dumplings across 19 themed collections, complete shelves, unlock changing environments, and chase faster times across multiple game modes.

neighbors.name: 自西徂东
neighbors.short_description: A text novel game based on the historical facts of the 19th century Just click the mouse Rich story and extended collection system

neighbors.name: XZ: XL
neighbors.short_description: XXZ 2 is a game on the edge of two genres – RPG and survival horror. One year has passed since the Zombie apocalypse happened. neighbors.name: TexanLand
neighbors.short_description: Pick a side. Or burn it down anyway. TexanLand is an open world zombie survival game with four factions, dismemberment-heavy combat, and total freedom to play the villain, the hero, or whatever's funniest.

neighbors.name: Zack Y
neighbors.short_description: Zack Y is a 2D Old School Scifi themed platform action game based on the story of the Alien called Zack Y whose mission is to rule over the Earth.

neighbors.name: Fishy Dish
neighbors.short_description: Create and sell sushi in this roguelike inventory-management sushi-builder game. Collect fish, sauces, and tools, arrange them on a grid to trigger synergies, survive each round’s sales target, and build the ultimate sushi lineup.

neighbors.name: Wild Bunch
neighbors.short_description: "Wild Bunch" is a unique puzzle game, combining cute cartoon graphics, four main characters and addictive gameplay. It uses a "tile sliding" format as a base for it's puzzles, that progress from easy to difficult. There is a lot of variety to the levels and puzzles, across six unique worlds.

neighbors.name: All About Luck
neighbors.short_description: All About Luck is a roguelike auto battler where luck is everything. Build your formation by gacha and test your fortune. No P2W, no grinding — just pulls, rolls, and fate. Crush the boss with god-tier pulls, then ask your friends: Still not cleared it?

neighbors.name: Mate
neighbors.short_description: An open-world adventure game set in a rural Japanese town, the game allows players to form teams of up to four out of 16 characters and control each character individually to explore various locations and solve troubles. Unique characters color the dramatic story in a beautifully landscaped setting.

neighbors.name: The Doorbreaker
neighbors.short_description: The Doorbreaker is a story about one very patient person who has a long way to go in the obscurity. The game includes more than 26 different levels where you have to break doors with a random chance. This game requires you to be patient and tough, I warn you!

neighbors.name: Clue/Cluedo: Classic Edition
neighbors.short_description: The official digital version of Hasbro’s classic mystery board game, Cluedo (Clue). Roll the dice and launch into a murder investigation. Whodunit? With what weapon? Where? You’ll need all your brain power to find the answers you need, as you race your friends and family to the truth!

neighbors.name: Bad Magpie
neighbors.short_description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

neighbors.name: Railway Empire 2
neighbors.short_description: Don the coat of a clever entrepreneur, take over a small railway company in the early 1800s and turn your steam engines into the workhorses of the economy. Grow your company into the largest railway company of the continent and outsmart your competitors.

neighbors.name: The Last Element
neighbors.short_description: The Last Element is a platformer game, that challenge you. Gon on a journey in this strange world, full of hurt and cunning. Explore black&white location, solve difficult puzzles, destroy your enemies. Try to find last element and solve main nystery of this universe.

neighbors.name: Another World Adventures
neighbors.short_description: Three highschool students got transported to another world, a comedy adventure begins. Shuichiro the weird who loves to wear mascot, Takeshi the popular the so called prince of tennis in school and Tosaka the cool headed girl.

neighbors.name: Raincouver
neighbors.short_description: Welcome to Raincouver, a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis on the brink of oblivion. With the city falling into chaos, the government races to eliminate the threat, setting the stage for a desperate mission to rescue your loved one before Raincouver is reduced to ashes at ground zero.

neighbors.name: CDB6: A Maldição dos Zumbis
neighbors.short_description: Prepare-se para correr, arrasar e se destacar no mundo das blogueiras no game oficial do Corrida das Blogueiras!

neighbors.name: Ice Cream Truck Simulator
neighbors.short_description: Start your engine and cool down the city! Hop into your fully interactive ice cream truck, drive through the neighborhood, and build your own ice cream empire. Take orders, scoop the perfect flavors, operate the card terminal, and manage your inventory on your in game laptop.

neighbors.name: City Transport Simulator 2025
neighbors.short_description: The All-in-One Simulation! Drive highly detailed and licensed real buses & trams, build and design your own transport company, and grow your network in a European-inspired city.

neighbors.name: Night Creed
neighbors.short_description: In the ruined lands of an ancient kingdom, evil, hidden for centuries in the ruins of old castles, awakens. Monsters begin to emerge from dark rifts, filling the deserted fortresses and forgotten roads.

neighbors.name: Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days 2
neighbors.short_description: "Cardfight!! Vanguard," has newly come to digital game! Over 3,000 cards for the Standard format! A brand-new original story shares the world of anime series unfolds! Enjoy your own cardfight experience!!

neighbors.name: Rebellion: Rise of the Damned
neighbors.short_description: Rebellion: Rise Of The Damned is an erotic Visual Novel made for ADULTS ONLY. You’ll following the Rebellion and be a key member in destroying the Roman Empire. Huge character cast, beautiful women, lots of nudity. We still have it all.

neighbors.name: Hellstorm: Reign
neighbors.short_description: Hellstorm: Reign is a story-driven first-person shooter game where you play as an advanced soldier from Itopia. In the game, you infiltrate the dystopian wasteland and complete missions assigned to you, all while uncovering the hidden secrets of Itopia.

neighbors.name: JOIN
neighbors.short_description: Play inside your favorite streamer's 3D world. Jump into their server, play with other fans in real time, and support your streamer — all in one place. Free to play.

neighbors.name: Anime Shop Simulator ✨
neighbors.short_description: Manage your own anime shop 🎌. Play solo or team up with friends 🤝 in 4-player co-op mode to grow your business 📈 Stock shelves with manga, figures, and collectible cards in this immersive first-person game 🕹️.

neighbors.name: Mugen Journey
neighbors.short_description: Accompany your mecha ally in this wild platform game. Dodge the crazy storms to survive and manage to capture all the shards through your path to victory.

neighbors.name: Inkjet Apocalypse
neighbors.short_description: Inkjet Apocalypse is a hand-drawn 2D shoot 'em up with rogue-like elements. Step into the shoes of a Work From Home Mercenary living in 1998, and pilot a Combat Marionette from the comfort of your own home as you take on contracts, earn upgrades, and rise through the ranks of the mercenary world.

neighbors.name: LOOK UP, JIMMY
neighbors.short_description: 目を覚ましたその場所はどこか見覚えのある風景、見覚えのあるモノに溢れた世界。主人公ができることはその世界のモノを「スキャン」すること。自分より大きなモノと遭遇し、スキャンしながら進んでいく。ピクセルドットで構成された懐かしい風景が見える世界を上下左右に進みながら探索する。スキャンされたモノは記憶に刻み込まれ、データとして参照可能。その数は100種類以上。モノに溢れた世界を丸ごとスキャンしてしまおう。

neighbors.name: 时光餐厅
neighbors.short_description: 《时光餐厅》是一款轻松休闲的餐厅经营游戏。你将从一家小餐馆开始，安排厨师做菜、服务员上菜，接待不断到来的顾客。随着生意越来越好，你可以扩展餐厅规模、解锁更多菜品，让自己的餐厅变得越来越热闹。

neighbors.name: Gemstroids
neighbors.short_description: Start with one weak laser. End with lightning across the screen and billions per session. Gemstroids is an incremental space-mining game: steer through asteroid fields while your lasers crack them, clear each wave for a richer one, then spend it all on upgrades and go deeper.

neighbors.name: Cobble Climber
neighbors.short_description: Cobble climber is a difficult climbing game where each hold has a countdown. Taking too long will increase the risk of drowning in the rising water level.

neighbors.name: Orbitous
neighbors.short_description: Orbitous is an action roguelike where every object has gravity. Every planet, moon, star, enemy, projectile, is attracted to one another. Nothing is stationary in this procedurally generated galaxy. Fly between star systems, build weapons, and fight enemies.

neighbors.name: Nothing But Cats
neighbors.short_description: This is a game that fills your desktop with cats. Cats will constantly spawn to clutter your screen until you either have a mental breakdown or your soul is healed! You can never touch the cats—the closer you try to get, the further away they run!

neighbors.name: Rake
neighbors.short_description: Rake is a First-Person Horror game where you hunt down (or be hunted by) The Rake. Use Trail Cameras, Bear Traps and other tools to assist in hunting it down before it gets to you first.

neighbors.name: Vibe or Dare
neighbors.short_description: Vibe or Dare is a party card game where friends reveal truths, complete dares, vote on outcomes, and compete for the strongest vibe in the room.

neighbors.name: Bump in the Night
neighbors.short_description: Bump in the Night is a single player game where strategy meets psychological horror. Confined to one room, you'll use cameras and commands to direct NPC investigators and collect evidence. Each environment offers unique challenges and frights. Can you survive what goes bump in the night?

neighbors.name: Pickup Point Chaos
neighbors.short_description: Run your own pickup point! Receive, scan, sort, and shelve packages. Find customer pickups, then weigh and label outgoing shipments. Carry several boxes to save time, but customers may knock them down. Handle package rain, fragile items, and explosives—and don’t blow up the place!

neighbors.name: Secret Stakes
neighbors.short_description: Secret Stakes is social-deduction multiplayer game where players act as AI units tested in an aggressive simulation. Draft items, execute deceptive quests—from earning or burning money to bizarre actions—and sabotage rivals. Outsmart the system and each other, because only the best unit survives.

neighbors.name: Flood With Friends
neighbors.short_description: Nail a raft (or a plane) out of junk, load it with everything valuable or ridiculous and sail for the next island before the water swallows you up. Co-op physics chaos for 1-8 friends.

neighbors.name: Paintey
neighbors.short_description: Paintey is a freeform do whatever you want painting simulator! You can paint everything from your face to the entire environment.

neighbors.name: Hush
neighbors.short_description: Be quiet. Stay calm. Don't look at it. A 1–8 player co-op horror descent: search dark procedural levels, contain what you find, and extract — while a creature hunts whoever panics most. One shared panic meter, live proximity voice, and an infinite descent scored by how deep you get.

neighbors.name: cosmo cozy defense
neighbors.short_description: A cozy tactical space defense game where you command the Star Sparrow to protect planetary cores. Link with planets to recharge energy, navigate intense bullet-hell swarms, and choose powerful roguelike upgrades. Experience a minimalist sci-fi journey built for calm yet decisive captains.

neighbors.name: Flawless Abbey
neighbors.short_description: You are a dreamseeker. At least, that's what she wants you to believe. Play every role, open every door, and delve into cosmic debates with dolls that seem to know far more than they should. But remember, above all - don't break her heart.

neighbors.name: Faceted Flight
neighbors.short_description: Faceted Flight is a stylized stunt flight game designed to deliver the thrill of flight. Take control of the Hover Jet and challenge ghost racers in Ring Attack or just relax and explore Free Flight....or you could always hop into the cockpit of the Jump Seat and give Target Practice a try. What are

neighbors.name: Ego In A Coma (自我、状態、昏睡。)
neighbors.short_description: A world... where the existence of ego has faded One day, the One of Insomnia received a powerful sleeping pill. She swallowed the pill in the bathtub... and fell into a coma, Can the One who has fallen into the spiritual world escape from coma? Can the ego grow after getting out?

neighbors.name: Voiceover
neighbors.short_description: Voiceover is a single player game, inspired by Disco Elysium and classic JRPGs, where real world is shown through the prism of main character's mental disorders.

neighbors.name: VOIDWATCH: CrossLust
neighbors.short_description: After being transported to a world that is not his own and forced to confront the horrors of Voideo alone, Brian wonders why he's been placed in such an unfathomable situation.

neighbors.name: The Ballad of Radolf
neighbors.short_description: After years of peace an island emerges from the sea with the Demon race, now the Demon race threatens to throw the world into chaos. Can you stop the Demon race and restore peace to the world in this turn based RPG.

neighbors.name: The Directorate: The Spy Who Killed A Saint
neighbors.short_description: Play as a spy vying to stop unthinkable destruction. Sneak, fight and trick your way through countless grunts, guards and bosses. The 60s themed comical stealth experience will challenge you to foil the destructive plans of a malevolent overlord within pre-set in game hours.

neighbors.name: M.U.D.S.: Mean Ugly Dirty Sport
neighbors.short_description: Jump into gridiron mayhem with M.U.D.S. (Mean Ugly Dirty Sport)! This top-down action sports game combines rugby, RPG character development, management simulation and strategy into an original title you’ll have trouble putting down. And remember – the only way to win is to PLAY DIRTY!

neighbors.name: SZEN
neighbors.short_description: "The Symphony of Mysteries!" SZEN is a musical Virtual Reality safe-space, where we can leave our hectic, busy lives for a moment and enter a world where you experience a place of melodic tranquility and wonder. Sit back, relax, let SZEN take you away!

neighbors.name: Gender Dysphoria
neighbors.short_description: Gender Dysphoria is a Psychological/Body Horror that is a visual and audible representation of my personal experience of dealing with it.

neighbors.name: E-circle
neighbors.short_description: =Warning= +In progress +Broken English

neighbors.name: RKGK / Rakugaki
neighbors.short_description: Turn heads. Drop jaws. Be bright. In this single-player 3D platformer, you’re the only one who can take down Mr. Buff and his lackies to restore color and life to the citizens of Cap City. Accompany Valah and the RKGK crew on their journey to take down the oppressive B Corp.

neighbors.name: Bullyparade - DER Spiel
neighbors.short_description: For the 20th anniversary of the legendary comedy show, Bully & Co are coming back to the big cinema screen. And on your PC!

neighbors.name: Cum On Bus
neighbors.short_description: Cum On Bus 3D is a mind control simulator. You will be unlocking new sex scenes by controlling the character meet her highest mood and reward you by her body.

neighbors.name: New Eternia
neighbors.short_description: Disgrace is an action adventure game that can certainly require a lot of thinking from the player. Done intentionally so as not to be too intuitive, the player will have to rely on their observation and deductions in order to progress in the game.

neighbors.name: Zhuzi Subdues Demons
neighbors.short_description: This is a CRPG game, you can operate a team of 5 people to explore together. Combat is real-time, but allows players to pause the game mid-game to give orders to their team members. The controls refer to Dragon Age origins and Dragon Age II. If you like Dragon Age, you can try to play this game

neighbors.name: A Dragon's Tale
neighbors.short_description: An exciting reverse Tower Defense! Defend the tower from hordes of civilians, strategically place your monsters, and take on the challenge across 3 unique modes: Story, Hardcore, and Infinity.

neighbors.name: Iridium
neighbors.short_description: A frantic new 2d shoot 'em up with huge levels and truly massive enemy ships. Mixing game styles from Uridium, Xenon 2, Nemesis and R-Type.

neighbors.name: Super Safe Spelunking
neighbors.short_description: Super Safe Spelunking is an isometric SHMUP featuring rogue-lite elements and procedurally generated levels. Dive through striking biomes, swap weapons at the base camp and take on the wild shots of long-forgotten employees turned enemies. The only thing ‘safe’ about this adventure is the fun.

neighbors.name: Painworld
neighbors.short_description: Painworld is a hardcore 3D platformer inspired by Boshy-style challenges. Explore a dangerous world of anomalies, survive brutal traps, master wall running and gravity shifts, and throw fireballs straight into boss faces on your way to victory.

neighbors.name: DuneHaven
neighbors.short_description: Build your oasis town with up to 8 friends. Defend it from threats that emerge at night. Hunt down powerful bosses. Work the land, gather resources, and trade with travelling merchants. Explore distant lands and grow your town’s influence.

neighbors.name: Escape the Desert
neighbors.short_description: So you're stuck in a middle of a desert with a single flask of water... how do you escape? Do you stare at the sun long enough for it to stare at you back? Well, that might not be the worst idea. Try it out in Escape the Desert, a strand-type roguelike strategy game!

neighbors.name: Dreaming Diorama
neighbors.short_description: A casual cozy puzzle game where you create various dioramas. Explore and assemble dioramas in a 3D environment. Enjoy relaxing gameplay that allows you to create dioramas at your own pace with no time restraints.

neighbors.name: Octohill Ski Tycoon
neighbors.short_description: Octohill is a casual game about building and managing your own ski resort. Mark ski trails, connect them with lifts and watch your snowmobiles rushing to rescue those daring skiers who went a little too far.

neighbors.name: Hamspater
neighbors.short_description: Hamspater is a simple side-scrolling roguelike game that requires control. To keep your hamster alive and attack effectively, you must focus on movement control. Defeat slimes and survive for 20 minutes to get more gold.

neighbors.name: Meyow
neighbors.short_description: Meyow is a fast-paced survival arena game where you play as a spinning, gun-wielding cat fighting off endless waves of zombies. Dodge, rotate, shoot, and stay alive as long as you can while chaos unfolds around you.

neighbors.name: Mech Builder 3D
neighbors.short_description: Become a master modeler in Mech Builder 3D. Experience the relaxing process of assembling, customizing, posing and displaying all the 61 model kits with complete freedom without ever losing a piece.

neighbors.name: Bodacious Bashup
neighbors.short_description: Bodacious Bashup is a battle simulator with both open and bottle-necked battlegrounds. Easily place down NPC's and traps and begin the round to watch both teams fight and fall into traps in realtime. Red and Blue will fight to the death - but only one will win.

neighbors.name: Soul #531
neighbors.short_description: As a recently deceased ghost, you only remember one thing, You have to get back to your dog. Fight enemies and solve puzzles to escape the underworld in this action puzzle platformer. Explore the different layers of the underworld, and face challenges along the way, drawn in a charming 2D style.

neighbors.name: Omelet Rice Shop Simulator
neighbors.short_description: Cook Omurice calmly and efficiently to keep up with rushing orders. Forget the daily grind and lose yourself entirely in the world of Omurice. It is just cooking Omurice, yet something about it pulls you in. Why not experience the addictive fun for yourself?

neighbors.name: Rogventure
neighbors.short_description: Rogventure is a vast, procedurally generated 2D world that guarantees a unique adventure every time! It's a powerful mix of action, dungeon crawling, sandbox, and archery.

neighbors.name: Art Dash
neighbors.short_description: A short Rouge Like game about shapes and colors, its a shooter about using color to your advantage to pop enemies. Inspired by games like enter the Gungeon and binding of Isaac!

neighbors.name: Finite State Automaton Challenges 2
neighbors.short_description: In the second episode of Finite State Automation Challenges, you will use finite-state automata to overcome 80 challenges from character string manipulation, computer science, and mathematics.

neighbors.name: Limouzik
neighbors.short_description: Limouzik is a software that transform your computer into a music instrument and makes you a musician.

neighbors.name: Learning Geography: Countries of the World
neighbors.short_description: Learn or test your knowledge of 176 countries across the world. There are two separate game modes: an easier mode multiple choice to get started with and then a second mode where you have to type the names in.

neighbors.name: Master Bladesmith
neighbors.short_description: This unique RPG blends VR action and progression. Mine materials, buy equipment, build your arsenal by crafting more and more powerful blades. Battle in the Time Chamber to test your creations as you progress through levels, and build your character as you upgrade your equipment.

neighbors.name: Boyfriend Dungeon
neighbors.short_description: Date your weapons! Romance swords, daggers, and polearms to level them up in this “shack-and-slash” dungeon crawling adventure.

neighbors.name: Deity Driving
neighbors.short_description: An adventure car game. A pleasure trip. A dubious method to get rid of superfluous braincells. Deity Driving!

neighbors.name: AI-deal-Rays [General Edition]
neighbors.short_description: "Spring into action, supersonic Sylpheed." Become the owner of the female android "AI-deal", and prepare for high-stakes drama and high-speed action, all rendered in real-time 3D.

neighbors.name: Lyra Convolution
neighbors.short_description: Lyra Convolution : The Future of Gaming is Here

neighbors.name: The Strongest TOFU
neighbors.short_description: Be The TOFU. The one and only Tofu action game created by a real Tofu Meister. You choose one of three varieties, and in its endless journey it gradually softens, crumbles, stews, and acquires bittern to become TOFU.

neighbors.name: The Polynomial - Space of the music
neighbors.short_description: Experience the music in a new way. Feel it pulse around you. The Polynomial is a 3D space shooter with unique, fractal based scenery that animates to the music.

neighbors.name: Coffee Beans
neighbors.short_description: Coffee Beans - A fun and challenging Match 3 Type Game

neighbors.name: Helix
neighbors.short_description: Helix is a challenging roguelike shooter filled with many decisions, many of which you'll regret. Pick up all the guns, upgrades, jewels, and gems you want, but just remember... You can't drop anything

neighbors.name: Cash Crop
neighbors.short_description: The Delightfully Fun Cannabis Farming Game! Stake your claim in the lush Pacific Northwest as you and your quirky crew grow wicked buds, master the art and science of cannabis cultivation, breed new custom strains, expand to new markets, and flirt with law enforcement.

neighbors.name: Sinbadexpress
neighbors.short_description: Sinbadexpress virtual universe is a virtual gaming platform that works in the marketplace logic that brings buyers and sellers together.

parent_games.name: シルヴァリオ ヴェンデッタ-Verse of Orpheus-

neighbors.name: Hitler On The Moon
neighbors.short_description: The dictatorship and Quarantine did not end, so the Japanese authorities sent their spy into space ...

neighbors.name: KING's RAID RE:VERSE
neighbors.short_description: Experience real-time strategic battles in the RPG 'KING's RAID RE:VERSE' Combine hero skills and explore an immersive world unique to KING's RAID RE:VERSE. Join countless heroes on an endless adventure full of action and strategy.

neighbors.name: Operation Night Strikers
neighbors.short_description: Taito's 80's arcade hits hit back! Four milestones of the 80s arcade movement in one action-packed compilation!

neighbors.name: シルヴァリオ ヴェンデッタ-Verse of Orpheus-
neighbors.short_description: This is not a story of a hero.This is the story of the loser. It is a story in which a man who once escaped fights to recover his star.

neighbors.name: The Rocket Stop Incident
neighbors.short_description: The Rocket Stop Incident is an atmospheric first-person horror game with puzzle elements.

neighbors.name: Station Osirius
neighbors.short_description: Osirius Station - The State has lost contact with Osirius Station. You are assigned the task of recovering to the station and reporting what is going on there.

neighbors.name: Lost In The Space
neighbors.short_description: Lost In The Space combines frantic top-down action with fast, fluid and very addictive gameplay, with instant response to player commands

neighbors.name: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 2
neighbors.short_description: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 2 is a tour de force of Naruto thrills and spills. Impressively faithful to the universe of the anime, the game takes players through the Shippuden story arc. Ultimate Ninja STORM 2 has been remastered in HD.

neighbors.name: Lethal Application リーサルアプリケーション
neighbors.short_description: Fly through the air in the extremely inefficient way of gun recoil. The burst mode activated by pressing two attack buttons at the same time is All health, 3x attack and significantly increase charge speed Instead, full life recovery. If you're going to die, use it and bet on the reversal!

neighbors.name: Gamers Club Repeat
neighbors.short_description: Uha was one of those who got hit by an asteroid incident and was hospitalized for years. And now when he wokes up there's an unfamiliar woman besides him sleeping right next to him!?

neighbors.name: Gas Gas Rocket!
neighbors.short_description: Gas Gas Rocket! is an action-packed game that puts you in control of a rocket hurtling through space on an unusual and dangerous route

neighbors.name: Combat Mission: Red Thunder
neighbors.short_description: Combat Mission Red Thunder focuses on the hard fought Eastern Front battles of Bagration and Poland, from the swamps of Belarus to the gates of Warsaw during the summer of 1944.

neighbors.name: Raid on Taihoku
neighbors.short_description: Raid On Taihoku is an adventure game with the backdrop of WW2 Taiwan. By controlling the characters pass through different danger and safe zones, you will experience the struggles of human nature and cruelty of war.

neighbors.name: Escape from Chernobyl: Jailbreak
neighbors.short_description: The plot of the game will tell the story of the mysterious prisoner E-0308, who found himself in prison for a special content of the ER-03 project, near the town of Pripyat

neighbors.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
neighbors.short_description: Tokyo has fallen. In the wake of the 'Collapse,' time is your ultimate weapon. Unleash real-time skills, predict enemy moves, and deliver devastating counters in this high-stakes Tactical Timeline RPG.

neighbors.name: NRDominó
neighbors.short_description: Classic domino gameplay with for local and online matches.

neighbors.name: Active Opposition
neighbors.short_description: An intelligence agent has been kidnapped. Since the operation is not official, the state cannot intervene in the situation. The most suitable name for this job is Adam, a newcomer to the city.

neighbors.name: Player City
neighbors.short_description: Adventure game that integrates 3D semiotics with the real world through videos and photos of the city of Farroupilha (Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil). Take control of the character "Kiwinho" and get to know the sights.

neighbors.name: President for a Day - Corruption
neighbors.short_description: President for a Day- Corruption gives you the opportunity to assume the role of an African president. As such, you must make controversial decisions revolving around topics such as: democratic evolution, corruption, development aid- and cooperation.

neighbors.name: Indekos
neighbors.short_description: Indekos follows university students Roy and Doni sharing a rented room. This action-adventure game blends joy, romance, and personal challenges, letting players experience the highs and lows of student life while navigating their evolving relationship and balancing academics and friendships.

neighbors.name: OFFSIDE
neighbors.short_description: Between a Runner and an Hack & Slash game, Offside lets you play as the young boy through 4 exciting levels, in which reflexes and agility will be the key in defeating Olaf’s plans and getting back the soccer ball collection.

neighbors.name: Popo & Rob
neighbors.short_description: Popo & Rob is an action-packed shooter game that combines dynamic, casual-friendly shooting with a unique twist on movement. Engage in exciting battles where gravity is no limit. Choose your side, Popo or Rob, and immerse yourself in a world that’s bright, bold, and brimming with fun.

neighbors.name: Food Delivery Service
neighbors.short_description: A friend invites you to Nodaira-cho Town, a town that is rumored to be making a lot of money these days, and you work as a delivery person there, but little by little you get caught up in strange incidents. This is an adventure game that makes you think about what is the right thing to do.

neighbors.name: Janusz - A 90's adventure game
neighbors.short_description: Janusz - A 90's adventure game - takes place in Amerenia commune where you as Janusz are tasked to help members of local community.

neighbors.name: Slav or Not
neighbors.short_description: If you want to test your slavic knowledge and brain skills. Slav or not is the game for you! You can discover game modes and try to get high scores.

neighbors.name: Learn To Rock - Học Cách Chơi Nhạc Rock
neighbors.short_description: Learn To Rock – Học Cách Chơi Rock is an indie game developed by Trịnh Productions. The game is a mix of Adventure, Action, Rhythm, Simulation, and is set in Vietnam 2026. Playing as Trịnh, players will practice, overcome various challenges and recruit new members to complete his rock band.

neighbors.name: RoMiMiMi
neighbors.short_description: RoMiMiMi is a simple board game. Win the game and reach the last floor.

neighbors.name: 検索探偵パテ太郎
neighbors.short_description: Search Detective Patetaro is a free mystery adventure set in a shopping street in 2050. Trace patents, designs, and trademarks with young detective Patetaro, compare testimony and clues, and eliminate impossible answers one by one. All 5 episodes free. Your search query becomes your deduction.

neighbors.name: あのちゃんを病院に連れてって
neighbors.short_description: A game that was actually produced for the TV show "Anochan no Sasayaka na kimochi Desuga..! Take Anochan to the hospital!

neighbors.name: Nokori
neighbors.short_description: Nokori is a game where you raise a hero then you go explore with said hero.

neighbors.name: Bittersweet Birthday
neighbors.short_description: Bittersweet Birthday is a boss fight-only action adventure where every encounter is a unique and emotional showdown. Explore a colorful world full of endearing characters, uncover your memories, and battle your way through challenges that push skill, timing, and determination to their limits.

neighbors.name: Foragery
neighbors.short_description: Washed up on the shore of an abandoned island, you find that dying opens up an entirely new world beneath the living. Meet the people and their mysteries, complete quests, uncover secrets, and bask in scenery like no other in this story-based adventure game.

neighbors.name: Innocence Island
neighbors.short_description: Legend has it that the three rays of light in the sky are emitted by a prism that grants happiness to the one who obtains it. You never believed in that, but it is your last resort...

neighbors.name: Beat, Heart, Beat
neighbors.short_description: Beat, Heart, Beat is a psychedelic action-platformer where every attack is set to a grungy midwest emo soundtrack. Soar across the crumbling Psyche, recruit bizarre party members, and tear a path towards your withering Heart.

neighbors.name: Changa
neighbors.short_description: A psychedelic trial-by-fire journey to sever the knot of suffering. Mastery in movement and combat will be needed on this path to inner peace. Bounce, dodge, fly, and fight the illusions of material and immaterial reality in this new kind of arcade bullet hell.

neighbors.name: Ghost Moon High Noon
neighbors.short_description: Guide the half-ghost bounty hunter Valentina Sombra through the haunted town of La Enmienda in this western top-down puzzle-shooter. Fire off spectral trick shots and wrangle your environment to put down rowdy spirits and help the grieving townsfolk move on.

neighbors.name: Last Memory
neighbors.short_description: The soul, leaving its body, passes through the last memories in order to find peace.

neighbors.name: Shell Soul:The Skull
neighbors.short_description: A nameless skeleton awakens in a graveyard. To recover lost memories and uncover the truth, it embarks on a journey of self-discovery.

neighbors.name: EGGCONSOLE RELICS MSX2
neighbors.short_description: Seize enemy bodies to brave the mysteries of the deep! Featuring the unique "Spirit Ride" system and a cinematic sci-fi atmosphere, Bothtec’s legendary 1986 masterpiece remains a timeless action-adventure.

neighbors.name: Knight on the Moon
neighbors.short_description: Built for the original Nintendo Entertainment System hardware, this top-down action-adventure challenges players to survive and explore a hostile moon crawling with alien life, abandoned bases, and deadly secrets.

neighbors.name: The Queen's Quest
neighbors.short_description: In this top-down adventure, you are a bee on a quest to find the legendary Flower of Life. Along the way, you'll befriend allies with powers who help you solve puzzles, battle fierce enemies and overcome epic challenges. Explore four unique worlds and unravel the hidden mysteries of this realm.

neighbors.name: Codename Incubus
neighbors.short_description: Slice, dash, and parry your way through your inner demons in this fast-paced psychedelic journey! Dodge an onslaught of deadly projectiles and unleash your blade upon nightmarish foes that lurk within your subconscious. Follow a dissident dealer and a jaded philanderer on their never-ending trip.

neighbors.name: The Death Into Trouble
neighbors.short_description: Help The Death to undo his mess, collect souls between heaven, purgatory and hell. Run, Jump, Hide and Explore!

neighbors.name: Beautiful Life Show
neighbors.short_description: Welcome to the deadly stage of The Beautiful Life Show　a side-scrolling horror action adventure. As the star of a bizarre performance, you face fatal trials. Rewind time 3 seconds before death and collaborate with your replay ghost. Will you survive to witness what lies beyond the abyss?

neighbors.name: Shambled Spiral
neighbors.short_description: Singleplayer Genre - Weird/Casual/FPS Purchase now to possibly get a much better version in the future for FREE!

neighbors.name: Bug Off
neighbors.short_description: There's a bug problem, and someone has to deal with it; unfortunately, that someone is you.

neighbors.name: Timberheim
neighbors.short_description: Timberheim is a cozy Viking lumberjack game: swing your axe to chop down trees, carry the logs through the deep snow to feed the ever-burning fire, and watch the village rise one log at a time.

neighbors.name: mosquito
neighbors.short_description: Mosquitoes buzzing in your ear? Now you can get your revenge!

neighbors.name: Uriel's Chasm
neighbors.short_description: Religious de-programming tool

neighbors.name: Dumbass Survivors
neighbors.short_description: Mow down thousands of night creatures and survive until dawn! Dumbass Survivors is a gothic horror casual game with rogue-lite elements, where your choices can allow you to quickly snowball against hundreds of monsters. Except you're stuck babysitting the guy who thinks he's the hero.

neighbors.name: Little Adventurer II
neighbors.short_description: Third-person 3D casual games.which is suitable for people of all ages.Control your little adventurer to help NPC find his items.Knock down the little you need to start again.

neighbors.name: Fallbearers
neighbors.short_description: Fallbearers is a co-op dark-humor simulation where you and a colleague transport the deceased, grappling with volatile ragdoll physics, changing terrain, and pesky obstacles in the Victorian streets. Please ensure the client arrives in one piece (we certainly won't).

neighbors.name: Anidema
neighbors.short_description: ANIDEMA is a desktop companion simulation featuring a customizable character who explores your screen, reacts to your actions, and plays mini-games. Genre: Casual Life Sim. Endless replayability.

neighbors.name: Erstwhile
neighbors.short_description: Erstwhile is a top-down roguelike adventure set in a long-forgotten past, where eerie atmospheres blend with uplifting moments. Level up by battling a variety of menacing monsters that inhabit your region and face colossal species bosses.

neighbors.name: Teddy Terror
neighbors.short_description: Teddy Terror is a 2D Roguelite Horror with the environment as your weapon. Escape a child's nightmare and face horrifying creatures and vile titan horrors, by using only your surroundings.

neighbors.name: BRIGHTEST
neighbors.short_description: A simple entertainment game where we stay away from the enemies and find the necessary supplies and get rid of them.

neighbors.name: Crawler
neighbors.short_description: Crawler is a short / modern, retro style Dungeon Crawler experience, you find yourself alone, inside an old castle.

neighbors.name: Dukgies
neighbors.short_description: Dukgies is a 3d cozy, casual, time management, and strategy game. Trash and rubble are polluting the environment! Use the dukgies to collect the trash, grow plants, and destroy the rubble. Watch out for the trash monsters!

neighbors.name: The Life of One Dog
neighbors.short_description: A heartwarming story about the dog life. You will watch, life of our four-legged friend from it`s birth till death. Experience love and hate, joy and disappointment, loyalty and betrayal.

neighbors.name: Moonchild
neighbors.short_description: Moonchild is a turn-based RPG set in 2000s America, with a strong emphasis on strategizing and combining abilities and passive buffs. Combine your different party members' abilities in order to effectively destroy your enemies, as you explore the whimsical state of Frankland, USA!

neighbors.name: Naught Bots
neighbors.short_description: Make cute things cry!

neighbors.name: Kindawn: The Parish Remembers
neighbors.short_description: Kindawn: The Parish Remembers is a first-person psychological horror game set in Yakutia in the early 2000s. You return to a hometown still scarred by the post-Soviet crisis. But something else has taken hold there - and the longer you stay, the harder it becomes to leave.

neighbors.name: Somnata: Where Memories Fall
neighbors.short_description: A falling music game played with one mouse. Sink through a sleeping city as a teddy bear nobody came back for; everything you touch rings out and lights up. No timing, no failure, no difficulty. Miss every note and the song still finishes — one fall is one song, about four and a half minutes.

neighbors.name: Fluffquake Fury
neighbors.short_description: A light-hearted, fun, simple RPG where you play as bedroom hero Pippa Pillowfeather and try and beat lights out by using her Pillow to defeat any monsters in the bedroom! Use new pillow attack abilities as she progresses to different bedroom scenes.

neighbors.name: Glitchy: Not So Sweet
neighbors.short_description: This looks like a super cute spot-the-difference game, but it isn’t!

neighbors.name: FEMINAZI: The Triggering
neighbors.short_description: Stop straight evil white males from oppressing women and minorities and make them check their privileges!

neighbors.name: Slippery Sammy
neighbors.short_description: Slippery Sammy is an arcade game where you help Sammy to walk as further as possible in a snowy afternoon, trying not to slip so much on the freezing sidewalk.

neighbors.name: YetiParty
neighbors.short_description: A first-person parody horror. College goofballs are partying hard in the great outdoors - booze, boobs, and bad decisions. What's gonna kill 'em first? Cheap vodka, ancient memes, dirty jokes… or a bloodthirsty Yeti from the woods?

neighbors.name: Paw Party
neighbors.short_description: Paw Party is an AI-powered social party game community. Here, players can enjoy online gatherings and play tabletop games not only with real friends but also with AI companions.

neighbors.name: The Tragedy of little Joy
neighbors.short_description: The Tragedy of little Joy is a hand-built hardcore platformer combined with a deep and emotional story. Experience a dream full of memories and fears, overcome dangerous obstacles and explore complex characters.

neighbors.name: Milk and Pixels: A Cozy Brick Breaker
neighbors.short_description: Milk and Pixels: A Cozy Brick Breaker. Inspired by EMDR therapy, track the ball across gentle day-to-night pixelated skies, soak in mindful affirmations, catch fireflies, and unwind at your own pace. It's a nostalgic brick breaker for the rest of us.

neighbors.name: ArcanoPlay
neighbors.short_description: ArcanoPlay is a curated arcade portal: jump between family-friendly HTML5 games from independent creators, track your stats and achievements, and browse the whole library with a gamepad from the couch or on Steam Deck.

neighbors.name: Joy the Pug
neighbors.short_description: Meet Joy—the sweetest pug you’ll EVER see. Help him battle the cute but deadly Space Cats and send them back to their Milk Galaxy. Don’t be fooled by all the adorableness, though. This game is not so forgiving and you have to shoot your way to victory.

neighbors.name: 失眠诊所
neighbors.short_description: In today's fast-paced life, the pressure is suffocating, leaving people breathless. However, while slowing down in dreams to reminisce, sleep is lost...

neighbors.name: Becloudead
neighbors.short_description: Becloudead is a horror story driven, hack and slash cinematic platformer, set in a post-apocalyptic world plagued by a zombie virus. Featuring close combat fighting with a unique time based modular combo system, puzzle solving, nerve-racking boss fights and more...

neighbors.name: Roll it down the hill!
neighbors.short_description: "Roll it down the hill!" is a COZY game about rolling objects down a hill. Yep, that's it.

neighbors.name: The Static
neighbors.short_description: The Static is a 3D-platformer where you control a television-traversing ghost dead set on rescuing their spectral neighbors. Reunite lost spirits and breathe new (after)life into a once-forgotten ghostly neighborhood.

neighbors.name: iterform
neighbors.short_description: iterform is a minimalistic hardcore platformer with experimental respawn mechanic and ability to create replicas and respawn on them.

neighbors.name: SCP: Submerged
neighbors.short_description: Some secrets were meant to be drowned. SCP: Submerged is a linear psychological horror game following Dr. Bree as the struggle to survive takes a heavy toll. Leagues beneath the North Sea, who can you really trust when everyone is gasping for the same air?

neighbors.name: The Last Joy
neighbors.short_description: The play center was once a vibrant and happy place filled with children's laughter and the latest interactive toys. However, a mysterious accident caused its sudden closure. Nobody knows exactly what happened

neighbors.name: DownTheDead
neighbors.short_description: DownTheDead is a zombie horror first-person shooter that takes place in a once-secret government research facility. Get armed, and get out alive!

neighbors.name: Dustline 2D
neighbors.short_description: Dustline 2D is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic top-down shooter. Explore devastated wastelands, fight dangerous raiders, and survive in a hostile world. Use firearms, dodge enemy attacks, and battle your way through challenging levels.

neighbors.name: Directionless
neighbors.short_description: Directionless is an experimental Virtual Reality horror game. It tries out a variety of ways of using Virtual Reality to unnerve and disorient the player, with carefully crafted audio working with an interactive environment to pull you into a nightmarish world where you can't trust anything.

neighbors.name: Crash Cleaner
neighbors.short_description: Crash Cleaner is a 2D platformer where you run and double jump around 40 levels collecting wires, spraying viruses, and avoiding horrible death from said viruses. You play as a character inside a crashed server trying to remove the viruses that crashed the server.

neighbors.name: Back Pain Delivery
neighbors.short_description: Back Pain Delivery is a physics-based chaotic moving game! Empty houses, drag heavy furniture, load it into your vehicle and deliver it to the new home. Play solo or with friends as simple deliveries turn into total disasters.

neighbors.name: DRIFTED
neighbors.short_description: A paper airplane ventures into a vast world of darkness. DRIFTED is a narrative driven platformer.

neighbors.name: Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered
neighbors.short_description: Pickup Trash Simulator Is A Game Where You Use Physics To Your Advantage In A Park And Throw Trash Into Your Two Dumpsters! Whether Your Old Or Young Or Super Environment Friendly This Game Is For You.

neighbors.name: All Hallows
neighbors.short_description: Survive a brutalist rave turned waking nightmare. All Hallows leverages the "Echo Protocol" to deliver high-fidelity psychological horror where reality decays when you look away. Audio-driven, zero-trust stealth meets photorealistic dread. The harvest has begun. Can you anchor your reality?

neighbors.name: Scatteria - Post-apocalyptic shooter
neighbors.short_description: Scatteria is a 2D Platformer shooter with a big selection of different firearms and explosives. Many different post-apocalypse levels to choose to fight your battles against your enemies! And everything is destroyable, choose a new route with a grenade launcher if you need to!

neighbors.name: Saunageddon
neighbors.short_description: Investigate the FInnish top-secret project to end all life by proving to the Finns that you are no german spy, but a real local! Featuring 12 Sauna levels, meticulously crafted on real cottages and public saunas. Physics based Löyly throwing mechanics, and locals to meet!

neighbors.name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
neighbors.short_description: Peer beyond the veil and experience the ethereal in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a captivating neo-classical top-down shooter. Navigate the realms between life and death in this supernatural action-packed adventure.

neighbors.name: Paranormal Eclipse
neighbors.short_description: Paranormal Eclipse is a single-player psychological horror FPS set in a remote Pacific island laboratory. After a failed time experiment, reality fractures, memories turn hostile, and nothing remains as it once was.

neighbors.name: BomBom Saga
neighbors.short_description: Limited ammo, liminal spaces, a bit of pinball and cute and outgoing humanoid Kokeshi doll robot with an AI that becomes self-aware.

neighbors.name: Riley In The Abyss
neighbors.short_description: Riley In The Abyss is a stealth action shooter. You wake up as 'Riley'in an underwater facility to research the depths of the ocean. Upon waking up, something is wrong... Everyone is seemingly dead. Sink or swim in this short psychological horror game.

neighbors.name: 三魂VR/The Spirits Within
neighbors.short_description: A scene towards which everyone has a strong sense of déjà vu, An unsolved case that shocked the whole Taiwan. A mixture of local folk culture of Taiwan designed to awaken The collective memory of the folks in Taiwan. What is the truth? Waiting for you to find it out.

neighbors.name: Aperture Hand Lab
neighbors.short_description: Experience the high fidelity virtual reality of your own hands like never before.

neighbors.name: Ascending - Dojo
neighbors.short_description: In this VR-RPG you can bend the elements and use other mystical abilities to face every challenge.

neighbors.name: Sacred Siren
neighbors.short_description: Sacred Siren is a psychedelic virtual reality experience created for ᔕᙡᓮᙢ ᔕᗢᘎᒪᔕ's debut album, "𝔾𝕠𝕕𝕕𝕖𝕤𝕤", released on Business Casual.

neighbors.name: AMEN 11 11
neighbors.short_description: AMEN 11 11 is a hidden object adventure game set in an atmosphere of apocalypse and psychological horror. The player's task is to find objects hidden on the maps.

neighbors.name: Britannic
neighbors.short_description: Welcome aboard the HMHS Britannic, the sister ship to the RMS Titanic. Experience first-hand how the biggest ship in the world met its demise in 1916 after striking a mine during World War 1.

neighbors.name: Midnight Blanc
neighbors.short_description: A horror game where you pilot a crude sealed airplane over the North Atlantic.

neighbors.name: Ultimate Dream
neighbors.short_description: Ultimate Dream is a realistic tactical FPS with adventure elements in a psychologic and psychedelic world. Intense gunfights meet a heavenly realm the player protects while bound to a bleak social security supported reality he is seeking freedom from.

neighbors.name: Pleiades - A Subversion Saga Game
neighbors.short_description: A sci-fi, horror, thriller, mystery and conspiracy fps.

neighbors.name: Proton Pulse
neighbors.short_description: Get ready for Classic Arcade Brick-Breaking Action from a whole new perspective in Virtual Reality! The entity known as M.O.A.I. has attacked, and the fate of the world is in your hands! You have been chosen to compete in the most diabolical game of atomic paddleball ever to grace the 3rd dimension.

parent_games.name: Restaurant at the end of time

neighbors.name: 它说山雨欲来
neighbors.short_description: 50+ endings! A purely fictional fantasy world! Comedy script, dark plot — and the endings? Pitch-black. Swept into a storm, you need a boss. The revolutionary, the merchant, or the cult leader? Your pick unlocks different paths. You're a cheater with buffs — you'll survive. Go!

neighbors.name: Buffet Knight - Decadent Full Course
neighbors.short_description: Eat everything. Grow stronger. Save the Gourmet Kingdom. A charming action-adventure where you devour foes, solve clever dungeon puzzles, and battle monstrous bosses in a whimsical, food-filled world. Find the five Divine Spices and save the Gourmet Kingdom from the Demon Chef!

neighbors.name: Elder Ring
neighbors.short_description: As a Grand Immortal Cultivator(you), facing your greatest crisis! Having lost your body, your soul hides within a ring. Many people with different personalities will become your "master". Some of them are smart, some are stupid, some are greedy, some are righteous...

neighbors.name: Zantar & Other Stories
neighbors.short_description: Acclaimed artist and solo developer Mitchell F. Chan tells six funny, gripping, and heart-breaking stories about a fictional video game, the ambitious CEO driven to make it the most valuable platform in the world, and the would-be millionaires who are pulled into its orbit.

neighbors.name: Soulitaire
neighbors.short_description: Open your own cozy fortune-telling cafe: the Soulitaire! Receive your guests. Listen to their troubles. Lay the cards and divine their future! But be aware: Your interpretation will change the fate of their lives.

neighbors.name: Dizzy Dungeon
neighbors.short_description: Move, rotate and fall. Move, rotate and fall. Get ready for dizziness, find to best strategy to conquer the dungeon.

neighbors.name: The Sigil Engine
neighbors.short_description: Write spells. Guide a shikigami. Bring light to a moonlit garden. Arrange actions, conditions and loops to solve 60 puzzles across five chapters, or plan your way through a changing survival garden. Cast, observe, and turn a clumsy routine into an elegant solution.

neighbors.name: 小艺的异世界冒险-Xiao Yi's strange world adventure
neighbors.short_description: An adventure decryption type of game It mainly triggers the decryption level through the plot mode. In order to save the mainland, you embark on an unknown adventure, look for the mysterious badge of light, and get the power of the great magician!

neighbors.name: Restaurant at the end of time
neighbors.short_description: With the universe on the brink, what better way to spend your last moments than by running a restaurant? Handle chaotic orders, manipulate menus, and gamble with fate. Just watch out for those cursed letters—they might ruin your final feast. Good luck!

neighbors.name: Shokudo Underworld
neighbors.short_description: Run your own sushi shokudo in a mysterious underworld. Satisfy the appetite of your customers, collect suspicious ingredients from bizarre fantastical creatures, and realize your dream of creating ... the legendary Chawanmushi!

neighbors.name: 絶望ショッピング ZETSUBO SHOPPING
neighbors.short_description: You wake in a room with no windows and no doors. Your only link to the outside is a shopping site: ZETSUBO．com. A small allowance arrives each day. You buy water. You buy food. The contract runs thirty days. Today's listings: drinking water, cheap rations, a stick of incense, and...

neighbors.name: Devoid of Shadows
neighbors.short_description: Galidon is a vampire kingdom. You’re a lawful heir. The power struggle and an intriguing plot are in place. 21 levels contain quests and crafting. The gameplay is rapid, bloodthirsty and intransigent and doesn't forgive a single mistake. Devoid of Shadows is a heat in the chill dungeons of the Labyr

neighbors.name: Luck & Doom
neighbors.short_description: Your hero stands at the center. Turn the world around them and shape their fate! Build your piece pool, rearrange tiles, collect gear and develop your hero. Every turn costs time. Find your chance to win amid the chaos of fate before the demon lord arrives.

neighbors.name: Suffering with Tang Sanzang
neighbors.short_description: You are Tang Monk, in order to rescue Wukong, climb Wuzhishan with a golden cudgel in hand! For people who enjoy suffering, or those who enjoy making friends suffer.

neighbors.name: Wizardry 7: Crusaders of the Dark Savant
Big Theft Valkeala 3 Revenge
neighbors.short_description: Terentius Duval is dead and his Wife Mary Duval is coming to Valkeala to rob money and finish missions in this third part of third person open world action game

neighbors.name: XuanjiDiaochan
neighbors.short_description: Diaochan lives on your desktop. She speaks up when you're tired, remembers what you said last week, and writes you a letter when you're away. Not a chatbot in a tab — a companion with a voice, a memory, and moods of her own.

neighbors.name: Cursor Cult
neighbors.short_description: A tiny pixel civilization lives on an island at the edge of your screen, and it worships your mouse cursor. Every 20 seconds its priests read your cursor's trail as an omen: farm, build, trade, pray, study, or march to war. Just use your computer; your habits become their scripture.

neighbors.name: Peace Island
neighbors.short_description: Twenty years ago, the paradise was revived. After the signing of the "Tide City Peace Agreement", the Atlantic United States and the Blazing Sun Empire hired desperate individuals to delve into the cursed inner islands in search of those lost angels.

neighbors.name: CAPITAL
neighbors.short_description: The city is gone. Can you survive? Yuri is a soldier who is on training by C.A.P.I.T.A.L. which is an international military corporation. Can Yuri get out of the capital of Turkey alive and uninfected?

neighbors.name: Desktop Akari ~my cute companion~
neighbors.short_description: Akari is your cute desktop companion. She studies, sings, texts her friends, and tries her best… all to become someone you can be proud of. Unlock new dates as she puts her heart into everything — just to make your time together even more special.

neighbors.name: YELLOW*DEMON
neighbors.short_description: Destroy Mansa Musa's Treasure Guardians in this brand new arcade time-attack survival shooter! Feast on gold and treasure as you fight to become Lord of the Underworld!

neighbors.name: Big Theft Valkeala 2: San Piritori
neighbors.short_description: Terentius Duval is back in this open world shooter. Mission is again collect money bags and now he can use money to buy weapons and beautiful cars

neighbors.name: Those Who Know
neighbors.short_description: Those Who Know is a clicker game where you click the Beez and get "TWK" Tokens to get more power and become God. God is dead and this is all that's left. Might as well do something. Coming soon for free!

neighbors.name: Remnant Protocol
neighbors.short_description: The assassination of the Blessed Mother has plunged the galaxy in darkness. Usurpers rule with absolute authority, and blood flows in rivers of red across the stars. Only the Protocol can restore Her light.

neighbors.name: My Heaven's Dale
neighbors.short_description: Sent by the Moon Goddess, you arrive in Heaven’s Dale to run a carpenter workshop and uncover its former owner’s fate. Mysterious ghosts drift through everywhere! Live a cozy life planting, fishing, mining, and caring for animals while restoring the town at your own pace.

neighbors.name: Banana Clicker
neighbors.short_description: A goofy idle clicker about bananas. Click it, buy upgrades from a cast of strange characters, catch slices, survive banana storms and black holes, and dress your banana in astronaut helmets and devil horns. When the run tops out, ascend and start again stronger.

neighbors.name: Deadline Savior
neighbors.short_description: A desktop companion that grows with you while you work! Complete real-life work sessions to send your hero traveling, collect loot, explore dungeons, and carry accumulated progress into the next timeline.

neighbors.name: Stay Home It Rains Outside
neighbors.short_description: Your digital refuge at the Alpha Centauri settlement. Visit whenever things aren't going well. This is a productivity tool with game elements. Customize your second body, gather fluffy creatures, and tackle real-life tasks using built-in productivity features.

neighbors.name: Peace, Death!
neighbors.short_description: Peace, Death! is an arcade simulator with difficulties. In this game you play as the Reaper working for your boss, Death, and send clients to Heaven, Hell, or Purgatory.

neighbors.name: Joey's Nightmare II
neighbors.short_description: Joey’s Nightmare II is a cartoon-style roguelite deckbuilding card battler set inside a bizarre and dangerous dream. Battle monkeys, donkeys, turkeys, and undead horrors, build powerful card combos, and fight your way through a nightmare that changes every run.

neighbors.name: CAMERAMAN NEVER DIES
neighbors.short_description: An interactive horror-comedy adventure where you play as a cameraman trapped in a surreal nightmare. React to quick-time events, make life-or-death choices, and survive AI-generated terror in this cinematic FMV experience.

neighbors.name: Conflict in Vietnam
