neighbors.short_description: Classic real-time simulation game from the 80s designed by Sid Meier and Ed Bever. The third title in the "Command Series" of tactical wargames from Microprose, the game begins with the defeat of the French colonial army and ends with the Viet Cong victory over the South Vietnam forces in 1972.

neighbors.name: Dreamians: Card Battle
neighbors.short_description: Dreamians: Card Battle is a Roguelike Deckbuilder with creatures that can evolve and change the course of battles unexpectedly. Play with one of the 3 main characters and face epic battles using over a hundred cards to save the dream world.

neighbors.name: The American War
neighbors.short_description: The American War is a first person shooter that takes place during the Vietnam conflict. The narrative is told through comic book panels from the perspective of a US Veteran recounting his experience. The accuracy of this account is dubious, twisted by trauma and the use of military stimulants.

neighbors.name: Stop Reading the Cards
neighbors.short_description: Build a deck, define its priorities, and watch your strategy execute itself. In this satirical single-player roguelike, cards become parts of an automated combat system. Create absurd synergies, adapt your rules, and survive a tower that treats every run like a badly managed show.

neighbors.name: Lucid Nightmares
neighbors.short_description: Lucid Nightmares is an action deckbuilder where time only moves when you do. Build powerful decks and combos to face relentless nightmares in surreal dream worlds. In this blend of real-time/turn-based combat, reflexes and strategy are your only hopes of waking up.

neighbors.name: The Bagman
neighbors.short_description: The Bagman is an authentic retro 16-bit horror point and click/survival horror that layers in stealth, commandable NPCs, and gratuitous slasher gore! Time and events continually tick forward, and any of your friends can die. Many paths to follow, multiple endings. Will you survive?

neighbors.name: Men of War: Vietnam
neighbors.short_description: Men of War: Vietnam brings the acclaimed real-time tactics series into a new theater of war – the jungles of Southeast Asia, 1968. Experience the chaos of the Vietnam War through two story-driven campaigns that reveal both sides of the conflict.

neighbors.name: VERY BAD DREAMS
neighbors.short_description: Very Bad Dreams is an intense and demanding experience that will test your nerves. Forget everything you thought you knew about horror games, because Very Bad Dreams transcends the boundaries of the gaming experience. Developed by an independent French studio,

neighbors.name: Uspavanka
neighbors.short_description: Nightmares - all children see them sometimes. But what if in provincial Russia there are kids so harsh they can defeat the vile creatures from dreams?

neighbors.name: VIETNAM WAR PLATOON 越战排 (AI WAR Game)
neighbors.short_description: This game is a new concept card and flag game with the theme of Vietnam War. It is a light snack game prepared for the leisure transition of players who are tired of playing large-scale games like me and hand injured players. 2020.8.10

neighbors.name: The Monster Within
neighbors.short_description: A 50's horror comic themed deck building card game with roguelike progression elements. Stop yourself from turning into a monster, or embrace your inner evil and use your new gifts. Choose from a roster of classic monsters and duke it out in The Monster Within!

neighbors.name: Chainsaw Warrior: Lords of the Night (Classic)
neighbors.short_description: Based on the 1987 Games Workshop classic, a battle vs zombies cultists & time! Fight against hordes of Aztec Zombies, and the clock, to save reality from Darkness. Lords of the Night introduces an upgraded combat system, new weapons, powers, equipment and unique mini bosses.

neighbors.name: ROUGH KUTS: Night of the Living Dead
neighbors.short_description: Interactive Film: NIGHT OF THE LIVING DEAD

neighbors.name: Convict Team Tactics
neighbors.short_description: Turn-based tactics. 20 dangerous convicts. Suicide missions.

neighbors.name: Plane Ranger
neighbors.short_description: A casual 2D puzzle-platformer with time-rewind mechanics and creature interactions. It features 16 traps, 20 creatures, single-player mode and LAN co-op. Players can rewind time to avoid dangers and use creatures to solve puzzles, offering a relaxing yet creative experience.

neighbors.name: Wild Adventures
neighbors.short_description: Wild Adventures - is the simplest 2D platformer with surviving elements where you have to do different hardcore levels playing as a sheriff living in the Wild West.

neighbors.name: One Way To Die
neighbors.short_description: After waking from a terrifying dream of your own untimely death, you attempt to make your way to the Finnigan Brothers' Fun Park for its last day then back home again. It's like playing Russian roulette with five chambers loaded, but more frustrating.

neighbors.name: 进入后室 Get into Backrooms
neighbors.short_description: This is a back room theme leisure games, Enter the back room, avoid the entity, find the exit, and find the truth. There are cakes, milk tea and party balloons =) There's nothing here. Don't believe it=( Join us =) Run away=(

neighbors.name: Eldritch Tricks
neighbors.short_description: A cooperative trick-taking game where losing costs you your mind. Each mission removes a suit from the deck — and Dagon plays it against you. Every trick he takes, every investigator loses a piece of themselves. 21 missions. One of you wants the gate open.

neighbors.name: Dungeon Danger Traps 2
neighbors.short_description: Dungeon Danger Traps 2 is a free hardcore platformer with multiplayer, where every move matters. Dodge deadly traps, find the shortest route to the finish line, and compete for the best time!

neighbors.name: Escape Prison
neighbors.short_description: Make a plan to escape from the prison and watch out from the guards in this funny casual game. Draw the escape route and help the prisoners to escape. So what’s your plan?

neighbors.name: THERE IS NO SLEEP
neighbors.short_description: Everyone has nightmares every now and then... but what would you do if a demon trapped you in a nightmare and you couldn't wake up?

neighbors.name: DR.ROBERT'S CLINIC
neighbors.short_description: HorrorPuzzleRPG

neighbors.name: Cemetery War
neighbors.short_description: Put down all the monsters coming towards you! Collect points. A monster hunt game that won't tire you on quarantine days.

neighbors.name: Bubba Yuga
neighbors.short_description: Bubba Yuga is a 2-player couch co-op puzzle game based on the Slavic folktales of the Baba Yaga. Playing as a pair of tied together witches, you and a friend must work together with your walking house to capture all the woodland children and break the curse that’s been placed upon your family.

neighbors.name: Bandit
neighbors.short_description: In "Bandit", play as the Sheriff, a Deputy, a Renegade, or a Bandit. Bandits must eliminate the Sheriff, while he relies on allies to uncover traitors. Trust, traps, betrayal… stay sharp.

neighbors.name: Surveillance Unit 7
neighbors.short_description: Surveillance Unit 7 is a cooperative horror game where you take on contracts for mysterious companies. You play as a Unit, a specialized agent tasked with strange missions in hostile environments where strange creatures lurk.

neighbors.name: DONT BE FOOL
neighbors.short_description: A 2-5 player online co-op puzzle platformer where nothing can be solved alone. Move and one button — that's all you get. Every level teaches one new rule, then asks you and your friends to survive it together.

neighbors.name: Manifold Mansion
neighbors.short_description: Rescue the princess from an evil wizard in this point-and-click fantasy room escape adventure, featuring magical puzzles to solve and RPG-inspired party selection.

neighbors.name: Ball of Wonder
neighbors.short_description: Come with us to the magnicifent world of circuses.

neighbors.name: Galaxy Cleaners: Dracula's Castle
neighbors.short_description: Galaxy Cleaners is a physics puzzle game where you have to collect, clean, and organize different enviroments and deal with the many weird requests of your demanding client... Dracula. From all possibilities of time and space, you ended up in Dracula's Castle!

neighbors.name: Vacuum Ball
neighbors.short_description: You control a ball that attracts all kinds of cubes but try only to collect the white cubes to finish the levels.

neighbors.name: Opaloid Kingdom
neighbors.short_description: Take control of a sorcerer in a medieval fantasy land! Explore dark dungeons filled with monsters, travel through new towns and meet crazy wizards while fighting through obstacles that will test your skill through old-school arcade challenges

neighbors.name: Dragica's adventures
neighbors.short_description: Join Dragica on a magical journey through a world full of puzzles, creatures, and mysterious place.

neighbors.name: Squirrel Legacy
neighbors.short_description: Gather the power of the legendary Crystals, become the Legendary Hero, meet your trusty Hero Companions and defeat the Lich! Except maybe you shouldn't trust all of your Hero Companions.

neighbors.name: MUSO
neighbors.short_description: A ragtag, misfit group of five band together, defying fate and work to solve their world's many mysteries. Explore strange worlds! Meet colorful friends! Fight wacky foes! Near the end...you'll be met with the final question: Which side prevails? Hope, or despair...? Welcome to the World of MUSO.

neighbors.name: Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum
neighbors.short_description: Delve into the enthralling world of Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum, the acclaimed RPG Maker gothic horror game that'll take you on a moving journey of self-discovery.

neighbors.name: Wizard Mukbang: The Game
neighbors.short_description: Experience Wizard Mukbang like never before! You are the Mukbang Wizard, a famous food wizard. Battle cursed food and grab loot in this classic turn-based RPG as you level up and grow stronger. Gather party members and determine the fate of the Kingdom. Strange mysteries need to be solved...

neighbors.name: Legends of Mathmatica²: Under the Shadow of Certainty
neighbors.short_description: Legends of Mathmatica²: Under the Shadow of Certainty is a humorous retro style JRPG, featuring a 16-bit aesthetic, an active time battle system, old school puzzle dungeons, and a comedic storyline that is filled with word play and genre savvy silliness.

neighbors.name: Silent Hope
neighbors.short_description: Explore, fight, and produce items to grow stronger as seven distinct heroes in this silent world. Guided by the Princess, you'll delve into the Abyss and learn the mysteries of the King and his now-ruined kingdom. In a world without words, what hope is there for humanity?

neighbors.name: To Light: Ex Umbra
neighbors.short_description: Plagued by tangible darkness, a princess and a young man guided by a mysterious force must travel across the world to find the secret to defeating the darkness once and for all. They must journey To Light.

neighbors.name: HENTAI SHADOW
neighbors.short_description: Beautiful girls in anime style, challenging puzzles with good soothing music - all these are waiting for you in this game.

neighbors.name: Fairy Knights
neighbors.short_description: The new dynamic puzzle RPG! Hit the road with cute heroes!

neighbors.name: Vade Retro : Exorcist
neighbors.short_description: Vade Retro is a PvP exorcism game up to 4 player. Play as Demon and make your opponents go through hell, or join the exorcist team by choosing a specialty to save victims from the devil's grip in this action-packed experience.

neighbors.name: Videopac Collection 1
neighbors.short_description: Experience late 1970s gaming with this collection of 10 games for the Philips Videopac G7000 (aka the Magnavox Odyssey 2). From battling invading aliens in space, to leading your team to victory on the baseball field, to turning into a swarm of killer bees, this pack has it all.

neighbors.name: Pay2Win: The Tricks Exposed
neighbors.short_description: 'Pay2Win: The Tricks Exposed' is a Pay2Win business model simulator(adventure) that exposes the tricks online game businessmen use to maximize monetization. You become a warrior in a fantasy world and uncover the hidden secrets behind the systems.

neighbors.name: REVOLVE
neighbors.short_description: Revolve is a fast paced 1v1 movement shooter where every duel is a test of skill and reflexes. Players fight using only a revolver. With every defeat offers a card that changes how the game plays and enhances your weapon, keeping each match unpredictable.

neighbors.name: Landlords & Tax Evasion
neighbors.short_description: Landlords & Tax Evasion is a multiplayer board game. Own land, collect taxes, evade taxes, ruin your friendships!

neighbors.name: Darts VR 2: Bullseye
neighbors.short_description: The thrilling world of VR darts awaits! Compete in Zombie, 501, Killstreak & more modes. Challenge friends in multiplayer, customise your look and create your own tournaments. Whether aiming for the bullseye or battling the undead, Darts VR2: Bullseye offers endless fun and excitement.

neighbors.name: Priest vs. Poltergeist
neighbors.short_description: Priest vs. Poltergeist is an action-packed VR vs PC local multiplayer duel between the battle-hardened Priest and a powerful Poltergeist. Play on one PC locally or via Remote Play online.

neighbors.name: HYPER DEMON PVP
neighbors.short_description: HYPER DEMON PVP is a free online 1v1 FPS. Master simple but deep mechanics and defeat opponents in intense duels to climb the global leaderboard.

neighbors.name: Dominions 2 - The Ascension Wars
neighbors.short_description: Dominions II is turn based fantasy game in which you take the role of a powerful being that is trying to become the supreme god. The type of Gods can vary from magically powerful arch mages to old dragons or statues. The game features a large variety of spells and units.

neighbors.name: Duel VR
neighbors.short_description: Western duelling game for VR with PvE and PvP arenas.

neighbors.name: Warplanes: Battles over Pacific
neighbors.short_description: Warplanes: Battles over Pacific opens the next chapter in aviation history. Become a World War II pilot and take part in the campaign against the Empire of Japan. The sequel to the hit Warplanes: WW1 Fighters, takes dogfight to a new level.

neighbors.name: Bashtronaut
neighbors.short_description: Suit up, Bashtronaut, there’s been another invasion! Grab the nearest blunted weapon you can find and clock into this hack-and-bash adventure where you play as a seemingly ordinary exterminator in an extraordinary setting.

neighbors.name: Retro Vaders: Reloaded
neighbors.short_description: The original Retro Vaders game rebuilt from the ground up with a brand new engine, complete graphics overhaul and a heap of new content.

neighbors.name: Oh...Sir!! The Insult Simulator
neighbors.short_description: A Hilarious Insult-‘em up in which players must verbally take-out their friends and family in different game modes. Assemble witty insults using different word strings, and employ combos, criticals, continuations and more to battle your opponents both offline and online across multiple devices.

neighbors.name: Priest Simulator: Vampire Show
neighbors.short_description: A mockumental action game. Go forth and rock in the absolute weirdest and most messed up simulator in the history of sandbox shooters. Fully unprofessional English language version. This dub will have you in stitches.

parent_games.name: Half Dead: A Zombie Story Game

neighbors.name: Galactic Gluttony
neighbors.short_description: Agent Red has one job, to hide the existence of aliens. But when a UFO shows up and starts dropping their food everywhere, things start to get a little troublesome. The fastest way to get rid of all the food? Eating it, obviously.

neighbors.name: Maggie's Farmyard Adventure
neighbors.short_description: Maggie brings the story alive one word at a time, offering an easy to digest story mode which is fully animated and voiced. Increase the fun with interactive games and sing-along songs with lots of bonuses and surprises to discover!

neighbors.name: Half Dead: A Zombie Story Game
neighbors.short_description: In a world where humanity is fading, zombie Alex begins to change after seeing Sienna. A story woven with love, comedy, and sometimes tragedy. Watch interactive FMV scenes, explore comic panels, make choices, and reach the right ending.

neighbors.name: They Came for More Pasta
neighbors.short_description: "When aliens order pasta, only one guy can deliver justice!" You're a food delivery guy in this short, comical graphic adventure, determined to stop the monopoly on Italian cousine imposed by an alien invasion.

neighbors.name: RADS The Radioactive Apocalypse Dating Simulator
neighbors.short_description: A post-apocalyptic visual novel with choices and multiple endings. After being accidentally frozen in an Ice Cream Parlour freezer, our college-party-planning hero wakes decades later in a post-apocalyptic world of mutants, robots and monsters... determined to host a party and get a date!

neighbors.name: Something's In The Air Redux
neighbors.short_description: A sequel to the popular Date Ariane Remastered, but also a stand alone remake of Something's In The Air 2013. The "redux" version allows players to play as a male or female for the first time. This is also a satire of the multi-ending "harem game" genre with surprising twists and turns.

neighbors.name: Three Fourths Home: Extended Edition
neighbors.short_description: A visual short story set in Nebraska, Three Fourths Home follows an extended conversation between Kelly and her family during a drive home through an intense thunderstorm.

neighbors.name: Cooper's Cleanup
neighbors.short_description: Cooper's Cleanup is a top-down collect-a-thon. You play as C.O.O.P.E.R, a robot vacuum who is moving around a home, "cleaning" up the collectibles hidden throughout the level. However, C.O.O.P.E.R is new to his environment, and needs some time to find his way around.

neighbors.name: Rainbows, toilets & unicorns!
neighbors.short_description: Rainbows, Toilets and Unicorns is a fast-paced shoot 'em up / bullet hell where the only option to avoid pooping yourself is to face your greatest fears in a fight to the last splash.

neighbors.name: Nut City Blues
neighbors.short_description: A comedy-mystery visual novel about Captain Fox, Detective Raccoon and the danger of pineapple pizza.

neighbors.name: MINUS ZERO
neighbors.short_description: Triangle Service’s MINUS ZERO is a shooter that focuses on a tried-and-true shoot-’em-up weapon: the lock-on laser. It’s shoot-’em-up purity: just you, your lock-on laser, and a whole bunch of enemies. As long as you continue to blast away at the waves of enemies, you’ll maintain invincibility, but

neighbors.name: Cat Girl Without Salad: Amuse-Bouche
neighbors.short_description: Interstellar mayhem! A bounty-hunting cat girl! Funktasmical genre-spanning action! This one has it all — no foolin'!

neighbors.name: Sam & Max Save the World
neighbors.short_description: An open-and-shut case of petty vandalism balloons into a far-flung mind-control conspiracy involving former child stars, the media, the mafia, the government, the internet, and the bright side of the moon. Telltale's episodic classic, lovingly remastered by members of the original development team.

neighbors.name: Red Laser Z
neighbors.short_description: Red Laser Z is a FPS shooter with a unique weapon that disintegrates everything with one shot. A space station was occupied by aliens, and it's your job to climb up through 10 handcrafted stages full with secret areas, treasures and wacky NPCs to uncover the weird truth behind the invasion.

neighbors.name: Nowhere to Run
neighbors.short_description: Nowhere to Run is an interactive film with over 120 choices and 18 different endings! Embark on a journey with Lucy and help her escape the desert before her abductor finds her. But he's not the only one she needs to worry about...

neighbors.name: Double Switch - 25th Anniversary Edition
neighbors.short_description: Welcome to the Edward Arms, a mansion full of intrigue and shady characters who are never as they seem. At first, you must watch rooms closely, trapping any intruders with ingenious hidden devices.

neighbors.name: King Island 2
neighbors.short_description: Embark on an adventure to uncover the mysteries of Kaptivo's transformation into an Arcane Warrior in this thrilling hack'n'slash action Flash RPG and sequel to King Island.

neighbors.name: Big Heavy
neighbors.short_description: Big Heavy is a demanding 2D souls-like boss rush. Roll, block, hack, and slash your way to freedom from the clutches of the Sadist King. Only 11 colossal brutes stand in your way. Will you escape with your life or become another victim of the arena?

neighbors.name: Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop
neighbors.short_description: Run a bizarre shop from the basement of an old castle. Process strange and unsettling orders and survive escalating chaos in Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop. Keep your shelves stocked, your customers happy, and try not to let the chaos get the better of you.

neighbors.name: Serial Killer Life
neighbors.short_description: Poison, electric shock, collapse, spikes, fake accidents, are your lethal tools for making money. Your imagination is your crime efficiency only border. Please note that you can use hotel guests to achieve your highest priority of robbing the bank’s vault.

neighbors.name: One Week With The Mafia
neighbors.short_description: After a misuse of your home address, and the general incompetence of an old friend, you find yourself stuck with the Italian mafia hunting you down. In this parody of Scott Cawthon's "Five Nights at Freddy's", it is up to you to stop the mafia from wasting you.

neighbors.name: Priest With a Gun
neighbors.short_description: A late-night vending machine run is cut short when a demonic outbreak occurs in the park. Little do the demons know, Father Garcia is never unarmed.

neighbors.name: Junk Rush
neighbors.short_description: You’re a degenerate gambler with 28 days to pay your vig to the mob with your hotdog stand! Embark on a chaotic adventure with your mocking AI and schizophrenic Goblin. Explore the island, find bizarre ingredients, create insane hotdogs, break rules, cause chaos and do whatever it takes to survive!

neighbors.name: Mystical
neighbors.short_description: You are a novice magician at the end of his studies. During a course on the opening of doors at the temple of the Great Wizard, you have clumsily cause the disappearance of all the phials and scrolls that he had so carefully classified over many years.

neighbors.name: The King's Feast
neighbors.short_description: Take hold of the King’s Sword and its path as it flies through a bustling and grand feast. Choose to go the distance or smite as many of King’s conspirators as possible! No matter which you choose, there will be total chaos. Go forth, and make it a feast to remember!

neighbors.name: Death Rattle - Evil Onslaught
neighbors.short_description: Fight your way through the realm of Ulliadore on a quest that balances the fate of the entire realm. Use a variety of ancient and epic weapons to vanquish your foes. Find enemies weaknesses and avoid their strengths as you battle to become the ultimate warrior and protector of the realm.

neighbors.name: Stormshot
neighbors.short_description: 300 brilliant levels await! Come unveil the myth of Treasure Isle!

neighbors.name: Höllenburg, Hell Castle
neighbors.short_description: "Höllenburg: Hell Castle" is an arcade game with video adventure elements, where you must explore a dark and satanic castle to defeat the generals of evil. Collect items, gain experience points, and level up while uncovering hidden secrets.

neighbors.name: Offering Accepted
neighbors.short_description: You signed her contract. Now you press the button, forever. Every press fills the bar, every full bar drops chests, every chest spills cursed relics, and every relic makes the next press worth more. Fair trade?

neighbors.name: Mysterious Castle
neighbors.short_description: Mysterious Castle is a classic “escape room” game re-imagined for the modern day with a crisply rendered 3D world full of locked chests, hidden doors, and mind boggling puzzles.

neighbors.name: Tilebound:Mahjong Survivors
neighbors.short_description: Move. Auto-attack. Build your hand. Survive. Tilebound fuses Vampire Survivors-style auto-battler chaos with authentic mahjong tile-matching strategy. Collect numbered and honor tiles from fallen enemies, assemble winning hands (Pung, Kong, Flush, and more), and unlock devastating upgrades.

neighbors.name: Hexe Chambers
neighbors.short_description: Harness devastating magic, conquer dangerous chambers, and slay hordes of monsters in an 8-bit roguelike. Will you reach the sacred relic and break the kingdom’s curse?

neighbors.name: Blue Dimension: Save the Game
neighbors.short_description: Stop them before they take all the PCs! You are the last defense as the digital dimension collapses. In this fast-paced Action FPS, shred enemies, harvest their souls to grow stronger, and master rocket jumps to survive brutal platforming. Can you crash the system and save the last PC?

neighbors.name: Ginnung
neighbors.short_description: You find yourself trapped in a void of Norse spirits, who are out to help you… or destroy you. Find your escape in this tight platformer with emphasis on speedrunning. Use the simple but versatile movement to the best of your ability!

neighbors.name: Dark Roll 2
neighbors.short_description: A physics-driven 3D precision platformer where you roll, bounce, dodge traps, snatch gems, and race against other players’ ghosts through a dark-fantasy gauntlet designed to make “one more try” a deeply questionable life choice.

neighbors.name: HEXED DELTA
neighbors.short_description: You are a triangle. The world scrolls. Don't fall behind. HEXED DELTA is a fast-paced infinite platformer where everything - the player, the platforms, the enemies, the effects - are made from raw geometric shapes. No sprites. No textures. Just polygons, lines, and math.

neighbors.name: Swordformer
neighbors.short_description: Only two buttons for ultimate action: move and pick perks. Slash hordes, craft insane builds, and unleash wild weapons. Help Josh The Barbarian escape the Shadow Wizard Gang's video game prison!

neighbors.name: My Arcade
neighbors.short_description: An arcade bundle by CWDI GAMES. Includes three arcade games; Chaos, Meteor Storm, and The Eternal Maze.

neighbors.name: Voody Hex
neighbors.short_description: Voody Hex is a roguelite plateformer. Enter into a voodoo cabaret and curse yourself to increase difficulty. You cannot attack - Your only way to survive is to dodge.

neighbors.name: Blockdown
neighbors.short_description: Roll around on a wibbly wobbly grid through space. This peaceful puzzler is a 3D twist on a classic 2D game.

neighbors.name: 5 Dice
neighbors.short_description: 5 Dice is a more challenging and precise puzzle platformer. You have 5 "moves" per screen that consist of; dashing, wall bouncing, placing platforms, etc. Use your moves wisely and precisely in order to reach the end!

neighbors.name: Hostile Architect
neighbors.short_description: Who is the deranged mind behind those trap-filled stages from classic 2D side-scrolling games? This time, it's you. Your kingdom is being invaded by heroes. You have to construct the stages they will traverse in this fast-paced 2D tower defense game.

neighbors.name: Wadar and and: another dimension
neighbors.short_description: Wadar and and is a 2d platformer where nothing is guaranteed

neighbors.name: Voidstepper
neighbors.short_description: Experience the elegance of pure black and white in this unique platformer. Navigate through puzzle- and action-packed levels, manipulate gravity, and destroy terrain to overcome obstacles. Dodge mines, lasers, and turrets as you defy gravity and outsmart challenges.

neighbors.name: Wood Guy
neighbors.short_description: Craft your own adventure with Wood Guy, a charming 2D platformer with combat set in a stunning handcrafted 3D world. Master physics, solve intricate challenges, and customize your wooden puppet. Play solo, team up with friends, or clash in chaotic Versus mode!

parent_games.name: A Magical Honor "The Race to Rescue PFC Whiskers"

neighbors.name: Feastopia
neighbors.short_description: Feastopia is a Rogue-lite culinary city-builder, inspired by Against the Storm. Forge a pact with an adorable deity and build a thriving foodie metropolis in a bountiful land. With randomized maps and events, unlock hundreds of wondrous abilities, experience a unique adventure every time you play.

neighbors.name: Just Eat The Rich
neighbors.short_description: Take the role of Birdman, a delivery man fed up with his minimum wage job. Politics have failed him so he takes matters in his own hand. With an arsenal of weapons and abilities you can help Birdman take back what the Elite took from us and redistribute the wealth. It is time to just eat the rich.

neighbors.name: GTL Schedule
neighbors.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world where food has become contraband and hope is on the brink of extinction, you quietly ignite a revolution to warm the world with a spatula and love.

neighbors.name: SimuLadron
neighbors.short_description: A satirical simulator where you wield the powers of the State to print money, spread empty promises, and create the most legendary inflation in Argentine history.

neighbors.name: ObeyE
neighbors.short_description: In ObeyE, you will play the role of a New-Order priest. Roguelike combat, build your fortifications while planting magical plants. Craft and shoot all the Enemy you see!

neighbors.name: A Magical Honor "The Race to Rescue PFC Whiskers"
neighbors.short_description: This is an FPS Action-Extraction Game!

neighbors.name: Birthseederia
neighbors.short_description: Birthseederia is a narrative survival game combined exploration, resource management, rogue-like, in a post-apocalyptic futuristic world , deserved with scenario for multiple ending.

neighbors.name: Feodika
neighbors.short_description: Live your own story in a world of the early Middle Ages! Lead a dynasty, expand your domain, help your subjects, and don’t forget to leave an heir! Thy Kingdom Come!

neighbors.name: Beasts Shall Rise
neighbors.short_description: Find Father Shannon at the heart of the cemetery and end the drunken spree that has unleashed his inner demons on earth. Use your skills to keep the clock ticking in this fast paced shooter with rogue-like elements. Fight demons, vampires and werewolves while avoiding The Reaper's deathly grasp.

neighbors.name: Shoot the Shit
neighbors.short_description: Shoot the Shit is a turn-based tactical rogue-like action game where you protect island territories and a sprawling continent from relentless enemy drone invasions. Pilot drones, scavenge parts after each wave, craft custom gear with local blacksmiths, and adapt your tactics to survive each round.

neighbors.name: Plowing
neighbors.short_description: Plowing is a point and click simulation game, where you have to subdue the whole town in 13 days to establish order. Shoot. Imprison. Pardon. Hear the visitors out. Keep track of time. But most importantly — keep calm…

neighbors.name: Norland
neighbors.short_description: Lead your noble family in this medieval colony sim, facing off against class conflict, religious struggle, and political treachery. Tend to your people’s needs, uncover the lost knowledge of a fallen empire, and engage in nefarious plots against your enemies.

neighbors.name: 信徒:献祭
neighbors.short_description: Follower:Sacrifice is a Rogue-like action adventure game. In the game, you will become a tryout and challenge the trials set by the great god Besimis. Now let's get started!

neighbors.name: Sagger
neighbors.short_description: This is a BETA VERSION of the Sagger game - historical simulator that will give you control over all Israel resources to face the Yom Kippur War. With the help of your advisor and knowledge, you will acquire, make the crucial decisions that will lead the state of Israel to Victory or Defeat.

neighbors.name: Guards vs Goats
neighbors.short_description: In a long forgotten kingdom, a hero sent to rescue a princess from an evil lord's castle. What can go wrong? Guards vs Goats is a first-person, linear, medieval FPS, with a touch of humor.

parent_games.name: Everyone Must Die: A Western Standoff

neighbors.name: 2080 APOCALYPSE
neighbors.short_description: 2080 Apocalypse is a combination of action-adventure, mystery, 3d platforming puzzle game. In this semi-open world, You have must fight with dead robots and bring a master cube. beautiful adventure with dead robots.

neighbors.name: HexCrawler
neighbors.short_description: Lead a party of three heroes through brutal turn-based tactical battles on a hexagonal grid. Build powerful synergies, adapt to unpredictable encounters, and survive deadly procedurally generated dungeons where every decision matters.

neighbors.name: NumberMaxxing
neighbors.short_description: A match-3 where you don’t swap pieces. Add and subtract to rewrite the board, trigger massive combo chains, and break the game with overpowered builds.

neighbors.name: Fracture Hell
neighbors.short_description: Fracture Hell is a replayable arcade shooter featuring dynamic destruction and deck building. Choose a class, equip your favorite guns and build a deck of upgrade cards to beat your current high score and unlock new gear.

neighbors.name: One Shot All Kill
neighbors.short_description: "Perfect catharsis from one calculated shot" Meticulous planning and precise execution. Utilize every element of the map to find seemingly impossible solutions, sweep away all targets with perfect trajectory, and clear this game. Your meticulous strategy is your firepower.

neighbors.name: GravBlocks
neighbors.short_description: The abduction has begun! Can you meet the challenge or will you fall to these alien jerks?

neighbors.name: Everyone Must Die: A Western Standoff
neighbors.short_description: Everyone Must Die: A Western Standoff is a puzzle game set in the Wild West that's inspired by the chaos and uncertainty found in Mexican standoffs. Inflict as much carnage as possible and make sure all the participants die by changing the environment around them with a plethora of unique tools.

neighbors.name: Reversible Routing+
neighbors.short_description: A reversible × card-based grid puzzle. Flip the map and head for the goal.

neighbors.name: Zombie GO Remastered
neighbors.short_description: Zombie GO is a puzzle turn-based game with more than 50 beautiful levels. You play as a man who survived the virus and must run away from zombies. On some levels, you must survive people.

neighbors.name: Apocalypse Approaches
neighbors.short_description: Apocalypse Approaches is a time-travelling top-down roguelike where time is your health. Battle through procedurally generated dungeons and defeat enemies to regain lost time. Upgrade your kit with cogs, manipulate time, and survive as the clock constantly ticks down.

neighbors.name: Clay Puzzle
neighbors.short_description: destroy falling blocks. Shoot, destroy, match, and clear the blocks as they fall... and aim for 100%progress!

neighbors.name: Angularis
neighbors.short_description: Angularis - like Tetris, but based on triangles. Challenge yourself to "Think Diagonally" and master the diagonal movements.

neighbors.name: Viking Nudgers
neighbors.short_description: In Viking Nudgers, your cards don’t deal damage. they push, pull, collide, and topple everything around you. The battlefields are islands of hex tiles suspended above the rough sea, and one wrong move could send you, or your enemies rolling off the edge like a marble!

neighbors.name: ShootAndJump
neighbors.short_description: Every shot moves you. Each bullet's recoil knocks you back across a tiny chessboard surrounded by conveyor belts. Dodge, ram and chain shots with two guns, survive 5–10 boss waves, and build your run from 398 cards across 20 archetypes.

neighbors.name: !Dream
neighbors.short_description: “A ~10 minutes experimental interactive experience about guilt and war and dream”

neighbors.name: 兵王
neighbors.short_description: Experience the growth journey from a soldier to a king beyond gods, and immerse yourself in the passionate national battles. The vibrant graphics unfold a majestic war world.

neighbors.name: Free My Sight
neighbors.short_description: FREE MY SIGHT is eight easy exercises which helps You perform eyes movements and stretching mixing gentle music to relax Your mind and release Your stress: sometimes Your eyes deserve it: relax Your mind and stretch Your eyes

neighbors.name: War Chess
neighbors.short_description: Bring chess to life in a fantasy battlefield where every capture becomes an animated duel. Command mythical armies, outmaneuver your opponent, and experience the timeless strategy of chess through cinematic combat and immersive 3D boards.

neighbors.name: League of Pixels - 2D MOBA
neighbors.short_description: League of Pixels is a fast paced pixel art approach on the MOBA genre, with an average game length of 5-10 minutes.

neighbors.name: Memory Matrix Pro
neighbors.short_description: Single-player memory & pattern puzzle. Memorize a brief pattern on a grid, then rebuild it before time runs out. New layouts every round, adjustable difficulty, timer & score. Works offline (airplane mode). No ads, no data collection.

neighbors.name: WAR Card Game_uvr
neighbors.short_description: WAR Card Game_uvr is a computer game version of the card game "WAR" but with a medieval theme. Play at your own speed (fast or slow) with the auto-play feature! Save the game whenever you want and then load the game to continue playing later! Pause the game whenever you need to! The game talks!

neighbors.name: MINDFIELD
neighbors.short_description: Experience the powerful VR short film, Mindfield, delving deep into the world of PTSD. Immerse yourself in this thought-provoking journey and witness the invisible scars of war in a whole new way.

neighbors.name: War Remains: Dan Carlin Presents an Immersive Memory
neighbors.short_description: This is not a game. This is history. Presented by Hardcore History® legendary podcaster Dan Carlin, War Remains is an immersive VR experience that transports viewers into the nightmarish hellscape of the Western Front of the First World War.

neighbors.name: Glassbreakers: Champions of Moss
neighbors.short_description: Lead your squad of Champions into a fast-paced and tactile competitive arena where tactics, magic, and power collide. Master the battlefield in this real-time clash of Champions!

neighbors.name: Synthetic Orders
neighbors.short_description: A quick, hypercasual pattern-memory game. Watch the left-right yellow signals, memorize the sequence, and repeat it using two simple buttons - no grinding, no complex mechanics.

neighbors.name: Pulse Codex EP
neighbors.short_description: Decode the control glyph and challenge strange entities in a short audiovisual composition / videogame hybrid.

neighbors.name: Conflict of Heroes: Awakening the Bear
neighbors.short_description: This exciting new release is a faithful adaptation of the renowned Conflict of Heroes board game that won the Origins Historical Game of the Year, Charles Roberts Wargame of the Year and the James F. Dunnigan Design Elegance Award, as well as many others!

neighbors.name: Color Clash
neighbors.short_description: Think your eyesight is sharp? Most can't reach 20 points. Find the different colored square in a 10x10 grid. Start with 5 seconds. Correct +1 sec, wrong -1 sec. Color differences get extremely subtle. Mouse-only, windowed mode, perfect for quick breaks. Helps train color vision.

neighbors.name: vision\memory\maze
neighbors.short_description: visionmemorymaze - a maze game with visual memory and logic.

neighbors.name: Logical Now!
neighbors.short_description: Der Amiga-Kultklassiker Logical (1991) ist zurück — komplett in 3D! Sortiere Kugeln nach Farbe, löse Kettenexplosionen aus und meistere herausfordernde Level. Nostalgisches Puzzle-Action-Vergnügen für alte Fans und Neueinsteiger. Level-Editor integriert.

neighbors.name: ReLinked
neighbors.short_description: "ReLinked" is a pixelated Rogue-lite Action/PRG in a Sovietpunk setting in which you'll have to fight back against extraterrestrial intelligence and fend off countless waves of enemies!

neighbors.name: Finity
neighbors.short_description: We are a small indie team who founded Denpixel - with a dream of making great games with soul and integrity. Finity is an action-adventure-puzzle Sidescroller with a unique 3D-depth aspect.

neighbors.name: Kill All Clankers
neighbors.short_description: Kill All Clankers is a fast paced 2D Platformer Rogue-lite with Bullet Heaven and Twin Stick Shooter mechanics. You play as agents of the Prohuman Revolutionary Movement. ​​​Your objective is to survive multiple levels for 30 minutes and free humanity from a tyrannical AI surveillance state.

neighbors.name: Sqr(2)
neighbors.short_description: Sqr(2) is logical platformer with hardcore elements. It contains 3 difficulty and 100+ levels with different gameplay on each level. The simple controls & many mechanics with logical problems make game process more interesting.

neighbors.name: Gunlocked
neighbors.short_description: A twin stick shooter without the twin stick, Gunlocked is a sci-fi action roguelike about careful positioning and upgrade selection. Manage unique targeting systems across multiple weapons and upgrades, as you battle legions of alien ships, and then do it all over again!

neighbors.name: SiNKR 3
neighbors.short_description: SiNKR 3 is the culmination of the award winning minimalist puzzler series. SiNKR 3 offers a new slant on the familiar contraptions with new diagonal layouts and billiards-style physics. BY PLAYER DEMAND: multi-step undo.

neighbors.name: No More Grudges
neighbors.short_description: Step into a shattered world where every bullet tells a story. No More Grudges is a visceral 3D top-down shooter that marries razor-sharp gunplay with a gripping, shadow-soaked narrative.

neighbors.name: That Level Again 2
neighbors.short_description: That Level Again Part 2 A small logic game where all levels are the same but ways to win are not. The character just want to leave the house. Sounds easy, isnt't?

neighbors.name: Virtuous Western
neighbors.short_description: Virtuous Western is a strategy game located in the old west, where our protagonist must eliminate all enemies in the area, using a limited amount of bullets to recover your stolen horse.

neighbors.name: Dualism
neighbors.short_description: Intense arcade shoot 'em up / bullet hell with twin-stick controls, roguelite upgrades, and a white & black twist where opposites damage and similars heal. An addicting, challenging, and relentless experience where you must control light and dark to succeed.

neighbors.name: PIP 3
neighbors.short_description: PIP 3 — cute puzzle game with pipes. Enjoy a relaxing time connecting pipes.

neighbors.name: Wave Shooter
neighbors.short_description: An endless casual shooter game. where the same level is diffrent. Inspired by 1998 gameplay style.

neighbors.name: Plato Shoot 柏拉图激射
neighbors.short_description: This is a shooting game, where nobody dies. Use your gun to help enmies find their lover, at the same time, find your own lover.

neighbors.name: Reverse Gravity
neighbors.short_description: This is a platformer puzzle game where the core mechanic is the gravity-reversing gun in your hand. It allows you to change the mass of objects, so use it to solve puzzles!

parent_games.name: Phantom Thief Angels: Twin Angel - Labyrinth of Time and World - Re:light

neighbors.name: My Child Lebensborn Remastered
neighbors.short_description: Adopt Karin or Klaus in this dark, story-driven parenting game. Help your child cope with the effects of hatred and bullying. Balance resources to meet their needs. Based on the true stories of the Lebensborn children, you’ll make difficult choices that will impact your child’s life forever.

neighbors.name: Robot Legions Reborn
neighbors.short_description: Shoot in all directions to destroy legions of hostile robots. Upgrade your weapons to become the ultimate robot hunter. Challenge yourself with Hard and Arcade modes, both new to Robot Legions Reborn.

neighbors.name: Rleotha: Trial of Gods
neighbors.short_description: Help the young one complete the trial, set by the council of gods, on the planet Rleotha.

neighbors.name: Bionic Heart 2
neighbors.short_description: Sequel to the sci-fi visual novel Bionic Heart. The game is told from four different points of view: each character choice will change the outcome of the story.

neighbors.name: Demon Rising
neighbors.short_description: Rule as the Demon Lord in a dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler. Recruit AI-driven demons who talk back, build deadly class synergies, equip relics, and survive brutal heroes, bosses, and events.

neighbors.name: Willows: A Dream of Shadows
neighbors.short_description: A tale of two siblings struggling to survive their present and heal from their past. Just how long can they ignore that which haunts them? "Willows: A Dream of Shadows" is a psychological gothic horror visual novel puzzle game, featuring hand drawn assets, and a episodic branching story-line.

neighbors.name: BoB - Battle of Bots
neighbors.short_description: Welcome to BOB, a heavy metal bullet-heaven roguelike Mecha game where your skills are the only thing standing between humanity and endless waves of berserk bots! Survive as long as possible while obliterating waves of enemies, terrifying bosses and the megalomanical AI DAVE!

neighbors.name: Against Heroes
neighbors.short_description: Why wait for heroes to come for you? Build and deploy a monster army to eliminate them before they grow strong enough to defeat you. A strategy roguelite from the Demon Lord’s perspective!

neighbors.name: Tenebris Legion
neighbors.short_description: 1988, New England. Your father vanished after leaving for a new family. As a rookie FBI agent you search his remote house, falling for the temptations of your stepmother and her two daughters. An adult visual novel of mystery, romance and supernatural dread, where every choice shapes the truth.

neighbors.name: Crimson Animatronic
neighbors.short_description: Choose your path, survive, break your mouse from button mashing and reach disturbing endings! In this analog horror visual novel, you play as werecat radio host Daiane, who must survive the Crimson Order, a cursed cult of vampires, and Charkelene Chan, a massive red maned wolf animatronic!

neighbors.name: Goat Survivor 2
neighbors.short_description: Soul-harvesting survival action: a goat wizard sets out to conquer the demon realm. Mow down endless hordes, capture foes with Mind Control, and grow stronger with every soul. Simple controls, fast growth, screen-filling battles. Conquer domain after domain and claim the Demon Lord's throne.

neighbors.name: Project Vesperi
neighbors.short_description: Project Vesperi is a branching narrative sci-fi game where you play as Doctor Evelyn Roth, sent to investigate a potential sign of life on Venus. When an intruder threatens the only habitable station on the planet, your choices will shape the fate of those around you—and humanity itself.

neighbors.name: Tales Of Aravorn: Reign Of War
neighbors.short_description: In the second spin-off of the VN/RPG Loren The Amazon princess, play as Elenor or Saren again and embark on a quest to Zoltar, where a mysterious relic awaits you. It may be your only hope to stop the demons, who have launched a new attack under Zeal’s leadership.

neighbors.name: Flekkia
neighbors.short_description: A Roguelite board game where every tile counts. Play as an Archer torn between the purity of the Angel and the rage of the Demon. Build your equipment, manipulate the terrain, and turn your movement into a devastating attack. Dying is only the beginning to rewrite your destiny.

neighbors.name: For Mankind
neighbors.short_description: A pair of siblings travel to the Highest Mountain searching for a plant that can heal their accursed mother. On the way there, they will battle evil spirits, uncover the past and face the mysteries of the heavens.

neighbors.name: Pixel Survivors
neighbors.short_description: Pixel Survivors is a god management game. Create some land and build structures to keep your small society settled. See how long you can keep your village alive!

neighbors.name: Nelson and the Magic Cauldron
neighbors.short_description: This game takes place in a fantasy setting, where a young man called Nelson inherits a cabin from his deceased uncle Sid, not knowing, that the uncle had a magic cauldron during his lifetime. It is point and click adventure with a lot of humor - with many hidden jokes about other games and movies.

neighbors.name: Lord Clicker
neighbors.short_description: Lord Clicker combines Clicker and Tower Defense in one game. Click to accumulate gold coins and make your choice: buy populace to generate wealth on your behalf, or hire men to defend your village.

neighbors.name: Death Corp
neighbors.short_description: Death Corp is a classic 2D Point and Click Adventure game where you play as the young new intern for Death's own company.

neighbors.name: Insights - Maniac Vortex
neighbors.short_description: An old school point and click adventure game in a nostalgic pixelart look. Young journalist Thomas wants to write a newspaper article about the psychatric asylum in the small town Fuchsberg. Not knowing yet that he will be going on a great adventure leading to the greatest article of his life.

neighbors.name: Marron's Day
neighbors.short_description: Marron's Day is a silly pocket-sized adventure where you're a bunny trying to save the town festival! Help out your animal friends, play cute minigames, and explore this cosy and retro pixel-art town.

neighbors.name: Overtime at Holiday's
neighbors.short_description: Cleaners Bill and Jules land a weekend job at Max Holiday’s mansion - until they find him dead in the pool. Trapped in an endless overtime loop, they must move his body around while solving quirky puzzles. A darkly funny retro adventure where "Weekend at Bernie’s" meets "Groundhog Day"!

neighbors.name: Party Business Supreme
neighbors.short_description: Collect presents for the big client. Avoid forks that try to eat you, because you are a cake.

neighbors.name: The Beardless Wizard
neighbors.short_description: An evil scientist has kidnapped a kind, old wizard! As the magician's young apprentice, you might not have a beard, but don't let that stop you from saving his wrinkled skin! The journey will be fraught with obstacles but also filled with laughs. Take the most important step now: download The Beardl

neighbors.name: Is Zombody Home?
neighbors.short_description: Upgrade the house, customize the weapon and charge the special attacks, your cute zombie horde is about to attack.

neighbors.name: Dead eat dead
neighbors.short_description: This is a retro style 2D pixel art survival adventure shooter. You control a character armed with a shotgun and grenades. You need to search level for supplies and keys to open locked doors. You can push and move boxes and fuel barrels located on game levels.

neighbors.name: Tribute Clicker
neighbors.short_description: Your island depends on you: harvest, buy, sell, and pay tribute to the Behemoth before it destroys everything. Will you survive?

neighbors.name: Woodboy
neighbors.short_description: You have five days to save everyone!

neighbors.name: Before the Snow
neighbors.short_description: A charming strategic survival game where you build a village. Explore the island you have found yourself on, discover new technologies, but don’t forget to gather resources for harder times. Will you survive the freezing winter?

neighbors.name: Pixel Combat: Zombie Shooter
neighbors.short_description: Pixel Combat Shooter is a pixel shooter where you have to fight for survival in a world plagued by zombie apocalypse. Defend your home from waves of zombies, build a time machine and fight unique bosses. Crafting, upgrades and a nostalgic atmosphere.

neighbors.name: Throne Clash
neighbors.short_description: In this minimalist placement game, you will command your army to resist the enemy's attack. Simple operation, deep strategy, enjoy the non-stop battle fun.

neighbors.name: Midnight Grub Session
neighbors.short_description: Get down with the thiccness

neighbors.name: WackIt
neighbors.short_description: WackIt is a wacky action packed VR whacking experience. The goal is simple, whack moles with your mallet. If you do a good enough job, you will progress to more difficult levels, and if you do a really good job, you will get the tools to whack like you've never whacked before.

neighbors.name: Kirkileons
neighbors.short_description: Kirkileons is a single player Tower Defence game. The game includes 2 planets containing 20 missions each(40 missions). The game relies on an original spawning method. The amount of foes depends on the percentage of magic energy VS anti-magic energy that your generators produce.

neighbors.name: Bizarre Barber
neighbors.short_description: Grab your VR controllers, and get ready to snip away! Bizarre Barber is a surreal, fun & fast-moving haircutting game set on a subway platform.

neighbors.name: Fingers: Mini Games
neighbors.short_description: In this small game you have to control your physical hands. Interact with objects the way you would do it in real life. Virtual hands react with objects according to the laws of physics. The game will offer you some puzzles and a free room. Sleight of virtual hands in your hands.

neighbors.name: Mistress Of The Tower
neighbors.short_description: Welcome to Mistress Of The Tower! Discover a... highly dubious school for wizards, where you can learn to build huge towers. Well... in theory. In practice, expect spectacular collapses and twisted challenges, alone or with 4 players!

neighbors.name: Miniature TD - VR
neighbors.short_description: Are you ready to play a adorable tower defense game set in an voxel world? Use the VR controllers to drag and drop towers on a floating map. Defend your base from cute monsters like mini magicians, chefs, and dinosaurs.

neighbors.name: Simple LOTO Simulator
neighbors.short_description: This Simple LOTO Simulator was developed to provide employers of any size, with a cost effective method to verify their employees' understanding of the Energy Control Procedure usually required under OSHA's Lockout/Tagout Standard.

neighbors.name: Balance 100
neighbors.short_description: Now you need to control your hands to set those slightly skewed objects may drive you crazy once in a while.But don't worry.You'll probably be able to do it.

neighbors.name: Tactical Control
neighbors.short_description: Tactical Control: the 7-minute wargame. Simplified strategy with minimalist graphics and quick, intense games. Play short matches against random opponents. Fight tense battles of stealth, anticipation and surprise. Win with strategy, deception and cleverness, not with reflexes and clicking speed.

neighbors.name: China VS Roman
neighbors.short_description: This is a war strategy game with the mouse control.

neighbors.name: Throwing Stone
neighbors.short_description: Throw your stone, and you are forced to move to the point where it stops. The rule is as the same as golf.

neighbors.name: JANGDOK Delivery
neighbors.short_description: You just need to deliver the JANGDOK.

neighbors.name: Tempo Wizard
neighbors.short_description: Tempo Wizard is a funny four beats plan battle game.

neighbors.name: Moonbase 332
neighbors.short_description: Fun meets Frustration. Hello and Welcome to Moonbase 332, The fast arcade first person shooter. Austria has tested on the Moonbase 332 some genetically modified Plagues to use it as a weapon. Your job is now there to clean up. Fight your way through the Moonbase 332.

neighbors.name: Abrez
neighbors.short_description: Abrez is a fast-paced shooting game where you aim at colored cans. Some cans increase your score, while others decrease it. Shoot at coins to buy special balls: single, triple, or explosive. Each level lasts 3 minutes!

neighbors.name: Buzz Kill Zero (OLD VERSION)
neighbors.short_description: This is the legacy version of Buzz Kill Zero. A rebuilt version, Buzz Kill Zero: Version B, is currently in development and will have a separate Steam page. This version will be retired from sale soon.

neighbors.name: Six is Devil
neighbors.short_description: An incremental game about rolling dice until all dice land on 6. Improve your odds, corrupt your dice, and place bets to achieve the perfect roll. Can you get all 6s?

neighbors.name: Anti-Human: Arcade
neighbors.short_description: Drop into the arena, score as much points as possible by hacking, slashing, shooting and casting while dodging enemy fire and performing stylish kills. Prove your worth, test your skill, and do not forget the most important step: Show off your high score to everyone in ANTI-HUMAN: ARCADE!

neighbors.name: Too Many Humans
neighbors.short_description: Too Many Humans is a real-time tactics action game where YOU play the Zombies. You bring chaos, fear, destruction, death and finally: redemption. Humanity degraded too far into greed and is hurting the planet, your sister, Gaia. Incarnate the God of decay and save the world by eradicating humanity.

neighbors.name: Square Rounds
neighbors.short_description: Square Round's is a Shooter Survival Round based game. Can you survive all 350 rounds? If you can, you shall be compared to a Legend. Game difficulty increases. Saves your High score and High Round to try to beat your own records. There is a Armor and Health system.

neighbors.name: BadMan
neighbors.short_description: BadMan is a game where you kill BadMans and they keep spawning faster as you kill them.

neighbors.name: Zombie Shooting Star: ARCADE
neighbors.short_description: You become a beautiful combatant Rudy. On the planet XX full of mutants and zombies. Defeat zombies and mutants, find and destroy Mutant Core before it regains power!

neighbors.name: SPH: Neon Geometry Survivor
neighbors.short_description: Neon geometry arcade survivor. Aim, dash and blast endless neon hordes with 12 weapons and 5 heroes, climb two global leaderboards, and clear a 20-level campaign with 4 boss showdowns. A fast, stylish twin-stick roguelite.

neighbors.name: Pin Money
neighbors.short_description: Turn a rundown neon bowling alley into a billion-dollar strike empire. Stack absurd multipliers, unlock powerful upgrades, expand to 7 simultaneous lanes, and break the economy in this incremental idle bowling game.

neighbors.name: The War Enders Evolution
neighbors.short_description: The War Enders Evolution is an arcade style single-stage bullet hell game. Beat the game with the choice from three different fighters and two different styles.

neighbors.name: Binary Game
neighbors.short_description: This is a simple luck-based game where players generate a random 30-digit binary number. The goal is to win by having all digits be either 0s or 1s. With extremely low odds of success, the game offers a fun challenge and a sense of achievement when winning.

neighbors.name: graveyard keeper
neighbors.short_description: An interesting synthetic casual game

neighbors.name: SIX
neighbors.short_description: Roll the die. Every six multiplies your pot, anything else and it's gone.
